body:
Tomorrow is our first significant fundraising deadline of 2022. Hitting our 3,000 contribution goal will put us on track to meet our budget and help lay the groundwork for an important year.
#
Peter,
As campaign manager, it's my job to ensure our budget and goals allow us to invest as effectively as possible in our people-powered movement for bold and transformative change.
The beginning of the year is when I'm projecting what we can expect to raise every month — which affects how much organizing we can do around Pramila's fights in Congress, how much staff we can hire to help us get out the vote in Pramila's reelection, what resources we can put toward expanding our House majority, and every other piece of strategic planning we have to do for the next several months.
**Tomorrow is our first significant fundraising deadline of 2022.** Hitting our 3,000 contribution goal will put us on track to meet our budget and help lay the groundwork for an important year.
[**So****Peter, can you donate $3 or any amount now to help us hit our January goal?**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/9898?refcode=em20220130-997&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=997%2E420207%2EQVibrz)
**[Contribute](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/9898?refcode=em20220130-997&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=997%2E420207%2EQVibrz)**
If we miss our goal, I have to rework the budget — that might mean budget cuts or delaying some investments in our campaign infrastructure.
With all that we hope to accomplish in the next few months — passing the Build Back Better Act and expanding our slim House majority — hitting this fundraising goal is essential.
[**Can we count on your support****, Peter? Donate toward our January goal of 3,000 contributions before midnight tomorrow — any amount you can give truly makes a difference.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/9898?refcode=em20220130-997&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=997%2E420207%2EQVibrz)
In solidarity,
Lauren

As a veteran who swore to protect against all enemies, foreign and domestic, I never imagined “domestic” would include a white supremacist mob to try and take down our government.
Last January, I wondered what my own representative — Congressman Kevin McCarthy — would do in response to such a direct assault on our country. Would he stand up to Donald Trump, finally put politics aside, and call for unity and accountability?
He did none of those things.
So I did a little more digging on what — if anything — Kevin McCarthy has done for folks in our district.
Here’s what I learned:
He has yet to make good on his promise to build a new VA clinic — after making that promise over _ten years ago._
He has not addressed our poisoned drinking water in Bakersfield — despite multiple tests revealing it contains dangerous levels of Chromium-6, which is linked to cancer.
He has repeatedly blocked raising the wage when our district has some of the worst rates of poverty in the country.
He has turned his backs on the people he represents.
[**That’s when I knew I wanted to serve my country one more time — by running for Congress to fight for the people of the Central Valley. Chip in $10 to our grassroots campaign before our first big deadline of 2022 at midnight tomorrow and help power our fight to win in November.**](https://u1584542.ct.sendgrid.net/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953ykbrIoKFUeKFEa1cUjjjq-5MbvSDaSunAhY8K_5K9dHfcm4dMaSqI0Cvu8FwGqm8_pg9V-VQjt8zkl5N-qik5CHwZlSqf-cQPU3Dph80zXIXkQ5rPz8xel0XuXY4KNovmdtN9yWvNCduTEFZ5vqh3jLs50MrhkqI8aGd9X6JZPwmcf1sbWBwM4PZVQfXRnl-QMvtmMi2FDUo-gZZlYv1lECKw_TuNEEiIi9zlW11t4WhYBgJ0YsqDVcwuTA0ASPfVjSxKg8TrUpJS95tA0a1Cbyxt-mhr9zlfHCFVH7EuPZna2PKjHY00_3NrH6q4jRK3KWiKaue2uQv2CuM0THhBOr6Li5pjAOTvjvLfIvBg7bg/3j6/tuut6Kk9RASJ_FHcWUceEQ/h2/CTpoROh8wnaVXcfqw3oLLoS7g1kBv1m0sRPjLmM7T8Y)

I am working to unseat him because he does not work for us, the folks of the Central Valley who need his help.
He continues to work on behalf of corporations and for the very people that attempted to overthrow the government on January 6th.
This fight is going to take all of us — and we can win this because of the support from folks like you.

The Lake Conroe Boat Show is this weekend! | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/a7f9187bd0ab/volunteers-needed-trump-rally-and-lake-conroe-boat-show-15811790?e=82b2b364e3)

| | |
# Greetings Dan McKaughan for Texas Team!!

Here’s the latest update on the next volunteer event coming this weekend.

The Lake Conroe Boat show will take place at Papa’s on the Lake Thursday through Sunday (February 3-6). Click [HERE](https://DanMcKaughan.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3546b09b826f568403b576872&id=5ec0eec217&e=82b2b364e3) to sign up if you haven’t already.

We’ll be setting up Wednesday evening, and even though the weather will not be as warm as we’d like, it is expected to be a packed event with food, live music, vendors, and of course...boats.

We’ll send additional details for parking, what to bring, etc. as the event gets closer.

If you have any _nice_ Adirondack, camp, or folding chairs we can use (we’re hoping to have a fire pit), or any outdoor games for kids young and old, please let me know so I can pick them up.

Thank you!!
\--Dan

P.S. I’ll be asking for volunteers to represent me at polling stations during early voting (February 14-25). Start checking your calendars and be on the lookout for more information. Thanks.

**We’re 4 weeks away from the Primary!!!**

[http://danmckaughan.com](https://DanMcKaughan.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3546b09b826f568403b576872&id=b80495b22f&e=82b2b364e3)

subject: How to stop the intolerant left
body:
College campuses have gone absolutely insane. A student group asked me to speak about our nation’s immigration laws at the Un
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2znqv0gna8uvgprnkra3ghejtvi4hjqgm34ockesg_rp22sh2s8i66ob6cdj64oj6c3h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jm4qj6d9jmpqj7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65srnchr78pr1mopnco34e5o61d5imcrr4s9hc1ibac9gm8qb4sdkclij2t3h61o6fkjge9i3cc5icpp78cbmc3gb8p9gs2qj2p76cpj3aoljcdg75cj66jhb6p37m2qmash5u)
College campuses have gone absolutely insane. Here's one thing you can do about it that can really make a difference.
|
---
| | | [](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zu5og29po9vkcnhmikht7pupj82snomgop45u4d8_rp22sh2s8i66ob6cdj64oj6c3h2bs) Fellow Conservative, **College campuses have gone absolutely insane.** A student group asked me to speak about our nation’s immigration laws at the University of California at Berkeley, the so-called “birthplace of the free speech movement.” As you may have heard, my speech was abruptly canceled because leftist thugs decided to riot and the administration wouldn’t stick up for free speech. Unfortunately, I’m not the only one to suffer threats and intimidation on campus. Far from it. [ **Fight the intolerant left on campus** ](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zqikdd0vkkohnroc2j4leuokqo90c26dk5etd8ug_rp22sh2s8i66ob6cdj64oj6c3h2bs) As I point out in _Resistance is Futile: How the Trump-Hating Left Lost Its Collective Mind_ , ever since Donald Trump’s arrival in politics, **liberals have lost their minds.** But there’s no padded room to keep them contained! Instead, **these violent, masked lunatics have taken over college campuses, where young Americans are turned into automaton leftists just like themselves.** Young conservatives on college campuses across our nation are losing their right to free speech – and even the right to walk down the street without getting sucker punched – because of how intolerant the liberals have become. [**But lest you think I’ve given up hope, faithful conservative, there’s a group I trust that fights back against this onslaught and exposes leftist bias, abuse, and indoctrination on college campuses for all the world to see:_Campus Reform_.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zvcvd6bq04hccdt07lgrq9svdrcrvk5q01fb0490_rp22sh2s8i66ob6cdj64oj6c3h2bs) **Campus Reform, a project of the Leadership Institute, is the single most powerful force for campus free speech in America today.** By sticking up for conservative students and giving them the tools necessary to defend themselves and their principles, Campus Reform provides an absolutely essential public service. **Bottom line – Campus Reform uncovers the liberal schemes that the mainstream media wants to keep hidden... and they shut down the liberals’ indoctrination on campus after campus.** [**To continue their vital work, Campus Reform counts on the generous support of conservatives just like you – yes, you! – which is why I urge you to partner with them today by making a generous gift of $25, $35, $50, $100, or more right now.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zjce44eomiou5gd5i98r02c3oldmbacuer1b5vcg_rp22sh2s8i66ob6cdj64oj6c3h2bs) And to sweeten the pot – when you give $100 or more to LI’s Campus Reform, I’ll rush you a copy of my book, _Resistance is Futile_. Saving young conservatives AND getting a free book? What a deal! [ **Get my book here** ](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zr5f0n83h63fhihev53ghd1raoen006pebikn4b8_rp22sh2s8i66ob6cdj64oj6c3h2bs) Campus police at the College of DuPage in Illinois told conservative students they’d **“lock them up” for handing out copies of the U.S. Constitution.** Yes, that dangerous document that the created the greatest country ever known to man. A teaching assistant at the University of Nebraska-Lincoln harassed the student president of a conservative group for recruiting students. With a gesture from her middle finger, she shrieked profanities at the conservative student and called her a “neo-fascist” and “Nazi.” Charming. At Purdue University in Indiana, a staffer called conservatives “vile, racist idiots” and **threatened to rape pro-life students.** (And you wonder why liberals prefer violence to debate.) In all three cases, LI’s Campus Reform exposed the truth. Armed with investigative reports from their student correspondents on campus, Campus Reform got word out to their nationwide audience of concerned conservatives. And they brought it to news outlets like Fox News, Newsmax, the Blaze, and numerous talk radio shows. Ultimately, Campus Reform’s exposure of the truth got _results_. In these cases and many others, **Campus Reform’s quick and powerful action forced universities to change their anti-conservative policies, discipline leftist student groups, and suspend or fire radical professors.** I believe an angel gets its wings every time a leftist professor is fired for their outrageous and unapologetic abuses against conservatives. But Campus Reform’s fight to make the left see the light and feel the heat won’t be won overnight. **To fight the forces of the intolerant left, stand up for free speech, and protect conservative students who want to simply share their beliefs without getting a black eye, Campus Reform is counting on your help.** [**Please make a generous investment of $25, $35, $50, or more today to support the Leadership Institute’s Campus Reform, stand up to liberal indoctrination, and ensure conservative students don’t lose their freedoms on college campuses.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z3q1v4uhke67qi5ebjcdt3dmnpe4bf36168oi9o8_rp22sh2s8i66ob6cdj64oj6c3h2bs) Friend, let’s make ‘em pay. [**Please help Campus Reform right away so they can empower conservative students and strike back at the lunatic liberals.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z8530see3dj7a6he31me9j8e2i22e8avi6c3akc0_rp22sh2s8i66ob6cdj64oj6c3h2bs) Thank you. In liberty, Ann Coulter **P.S. Remember, when you give $100 or more to LI’s Campus Reform, I’ll rush you a copy of my book,_Resistance is Futile_.** It’s just one more way I can thank you for joining this crucial cause. Because **if we lose the kids, we lose this country.** [**Please donate right away.](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z6q98a5rh6akrcffkqd1onpmdrfa0ndmmo7lfqe0_rp22sh2s8i66ob6cdj64oj6c3h2bs) Thank you.** [ **Yes, I'll join Campus Reform in the fight against leftist tyranny** ](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zje7o8q064799kc31b80v4tgm42cga9dkssv4vq0_rp22sh2s8i66ob6cdj64oj6c3h2bs)

body:

| | For immediate release January 31st, 2022 Contact: (470) 588-2028, news@jakeevans.org
Milton Mayors Endorse Jake Evans Jake Evans' campaign for the Sixth Congressional District today announced the endorsement of City of Milton Mayor Peyton Jamison and immediate past Mayor Joe Lockwood. "Jake understands that an active and engaged member of Congress can partner with us to serve the needs of our citizens, from public safety to infrastructure," said Jamison, who took office the first week of January. "I ran on protecting our quality of life in Milton by upholding our land-use planning, and I want a member of Congress who will respect local control." Lockwood also praised Jake and his candidacy. "Having served as mayor, I understand the importance of having a representative in Congress who is responsive to the needs of our cities, and Jake Evans will provide that," Lockwood said. Jake said Mayors such as Jamison and Lockwood are essential to keeping the Sixth District one of the best places in America to live. "Gaining the support of servant leaders on the local level means so much to me and this campaign," Jake said. "Mayor Jamison and Mayor Lockwood have given themselves to serve their communities and have set an example I want to follow in office."

name: Ashley Ward
subject: Getting to know Ashley
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Friends of Ashley Ward
body:
https://www.everyaction.com/ [https://www.everyaction.com/]

Getting to know Ashley:
The Importance of Public Service

Too often we think that public office holders are the only public servants. Little is said about the thousands of us who volunteer countless hours every week in our communities without publicity or recognition.

image of ... [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/joel-muniz-3k3l2brxmwQ-unsplash.jpg]

When I was growing up, my mother, a single mom, didn't have money to give, but she gave her time and energy, taking me along with her as she delivered meals in our rural community. She also fostered at-risk animals, providing a safe haven for them when they were taken from their owners because of abuse. She and I spent hours bottle feeding and caring for the most unwanted and unloved animals.

My mother taught me the importance of compassion and giving - of caring for those most in need. Even when we didn't have money to donate, she insisted we had our time and energy to give. And so we did.

Read More About My Family[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/IMG_3469.jpeg]

My husband is a 30-year teaching veteran, I taught at UNC for several years, and our oldest daughter is a second grade teacher.
My family understands the importance of supporting our educators, our public schools, our children.

When my children were in school, I volunteered multiple times per week.. During this time, I was an officer in the PTA and led the most successful fundraising efforts in the school's history (and in the entire district), raising over $25K per year to support the Artist in Residence program and buy supplies for our teachers.

I helped teachers in Kindergarten and 1st grade with literacy, pulling students out to read with them one on one, increasing the teacher's classroom capacity to serve more students. Often I stepped in to assist substitute teachers when a teacher took maternity leave, helping out in any way needed to make the transition in the classroom smoother.

[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/GraduationDay_Girls%20%281%29.JPG]

During this time...
I was also a full-time student at UNC with two small children of my own. I graduated with highest honors from my Bachelor's program and went on to graduate school on a fellowship from my department. My volunteer work in the school system continued.

When I graduated with my PhD, I did not go to work in the private sector where my pay would have been twice as high as the public sector. I specifically looked for and took jobs in the public sector because I believe we need expertise in our public sector to address our most challenging issues .

[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/93808/images/milada-vigerova-XJoOb7EDXTw-unsplash.jpg]

Since 2010, I have taught online courses for a small, rural, under-resourced school in eastern NC. The school hit a crisis point about 10 years ago when there was no one to teach required courses and the school could not recruit the talent to do so. They reached out to my husband to do it, but with his other obligations he could not.
I stepped in, despite being paid a fraction of what I would be paid to teach the same course at our local universities. I continue to do it because kids in rural areas also need good teachers, but rural areas have the least capacity to recruit them, exacerbating already existing disparities.

This disparity became increasingly more clear during COVID when many of my students had no access to Internet at home and were writing papers and submitting assignments on their mobile phones or serving as primary caregiver to siblings at home while also taking courses to graduate. Teaching in a rural school reminds me of how important it is that we ensure the benefits of technologies extend to our rural areas.

I also volunteer with local community organizations, where I deliver meals to rural Orange County residents and assist in collecting and providing supplies to families in need, particularly during times of crisis.

During COVID, I was asked, and served, on the Orange County Schools COVID task force as an expert to help the school board understand the data and make informed decisions around COVID. I think the successful local leadership in Orange County speaks for itself. Orange County has maintained one of the lowest, if not the lowest, transmission rates in the entire state of NC.
Like me, volunteers work hard in our communities every day in the spirit of community service, without public spotlight or recognition.

It is these experiences that help me know my community and keep my feet firmly grounded in Congressional District NC-06. My name might not be as recognizable as some others running to be your Congressperson in 2022, but hopefully you will now know that I have a servant’s heart.

As your Representative, I will work every day to serve our Congressional District to the best of my ability.

https://youtu.be/HxSNEhqi_M4 [https://youtu.be/HxSNEhqi_M4]Please follow along with me!

Join our mailing list, follow the campaign on social media, come see me at one of our events, or reach out to me!

Friend -- Since he was sworn in as Attorney General, Jason Miyares has done nothing but stoke the flames of division in our Commonwealth, even appearing on Hannity on Fox News last week to score cheap political points with his far-right base. In just two weeks, Miyares has:
* Declared Roe v. Wade was "wrongfully decided";
* Fired every attorney in the Office of the Attorney General's Division of Civil Rights;
* Declared in his first AG opinion that Virginia state universities cannot mandate the COVID-19 vaccine as a condition for enrollment or in-person attendance;
* Made efforts to thwart the Clean Air Act.

Let me be clear: these policies are dangerous, and we must hold Jason Miyares and extreme Republicans like him accountable. That's why I'm leading the charge to recruit and train the next slate of Democratic candidates up and down the ticket so we can take back our majority in the House of Delegates next year and take back our statewide offices in a few years time. [**Join our fight today by contributing $25 or whatever you can to Meet Our Moment so we can get Virginia back on track.**](https://act.myngp.com/el/dwmhnic9bZmwiEDQ3z-QTMlWhO4BArhZlf7oH_wfLeI=/Qn_QA8Na4-I4_0wJtQ2pMf5c0N6grsDWBFTK0jW9ZXs=) When I ran for Attorney General last year, I said we needed someone who would work relentlessly to put people first. What we're seeing now is someone who will stop at nothing to turn back the clocks and stoke division. Virginia won't stand for it. It's time to fight back. Thanks for standing with me. \- Jay

CRT Is In More Than Education

| [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001g5LoTTc4i_1YRiJIinFwc7H7V2dOx11gtg7g-TxvMslpXRTcv6oYifUDDZrxnoTwO6LQ2u82wzPeBKsmUG716omqQa04ueUFH6_oyiQSbC_ICS0axPiUOswYFWA_TPg2jI6PWWsX9TwE4RjQ1Lp9AB0e0WYm8tIaDUFM3HD4V-E=&c=4Enn-RrAjCcTiFJyPkQxZTqKi529ld0unN2KLHblo0U4Ss6KSIylFA==&ch=jATsqdLBR35ruT1fYQiVF3sjomjXQP27x1qbVfONm4_1QSyTzoJlvA==)

| Dear Neighbor,
For years, we have seen our traditional values, our history, our institutions, and more come under attack. As a teacher, I have a front row seat as to how this attack is infecting our education system. Whether the unions or other teachers admit it or not, Critical Race Theory (CRT) IS in our schools. It is undermining how our students view each other and themselves (either as an oppressor or as the oppressed) and is churning out young adults that hate their country and its institutions. However, while most recent headlines have been about CRT in education, such Marxist ideologies are in more than that. They are infiltrating our healthcare system as well. CRT under the guise of "antiracist medicine" and "health equity" is transforming healthcare away from a science- and patient-oriented endeavor to an activist opportunity to "level the playing field." Its claim: any and all racial health disparities are caused - by racism - and not lifestyle choices. Already, this racially-preferential heathcare is [being implemented in our country](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001g5LoTTc4i_1YRiJIinFwc7H7V2dOx11gtg7g-TxvMslpXRTcv6oYiQ_pifEzE0-Kv1gNyPRzb5FMzthvsW_2M8yvdj3Q1pRuhE-Id8TA0A5sny7ivWxcTOCpKyodVtu3QPbviMmOM9Rm5l5EpAJdFtOv2Z8pAzONLuyvvKtPmLW4Ors8nZ3rx0DLuTOt_w68&c=4Enn-RrAjCcTiFJyPkQxZTqKi529ld0unN2KLHblo0U4Ss6KSIylFA==&ch=jATsqdLBR35ruT1fYQiVF3sjomjXQP27x1qbVfONm4_1QSyTzoJlvA==), enabling medical practitioners to consider race as a risk factor when allocating scarce COVID-19 treatments and so prioritizing the medical treatment of non-white patients over white patients. So, where are we seeing this? Let's look.

* As of January 1, under new Department of Health and Human Services guidelines, the Biden administration is paying bonuses to physicians who acknowledge systemic racism as the primary cause of health differences between racial groups.
* Medical professionals have advocated for prioritizing black and Latino patients when rationing limited, life-saving medical resources.
* The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) prioritized vaccines for essential workers over the elderly since demographically, the elderly are more white, and essential workers tend be less white. This happened regardless of the well-documented fact that the elderly are of the highest risk for contracting and dying from COVID-19.
* Vermont granted vaccine priority to non-white households prior to deeming the general public eligible for vaccination.
* A Boston hospital advocated to base admissions for cardiological services on race (black and Latino).
* The University of Pennsylvania medical school pushed to have race accounted for when rationing ventilators.
* In Houston this past December, on their appointment form for monoclonal antibodies treatment, an urgent care facility included race (black/Hispanic) as one of the determining factors for prioritizing treatment.

It's insane that I even have to say this, but all people should be given the same priority, treatment, and care regardless of their skin color. But, this is where we are now, and this is the evil we are battling against. We need representation in Congress that will actively stand against and defeat these insidious ideologies and policies. I promise you that as your congressman, I will stand for what is right and work to rid ALL our systems of this Marxist rot.

clean_body: CRT Is In More Than Education | | | | | | == | | | | | Dear Neighbor, For years, we have seen our traditional values, our history, our institutions, and more come under attack. As a teacher, I have a front row seat as to how this attack is infecting our education system. Whether the unions or other teachers admit it or not, Critical Race Theory (CRT) IS in our schools. It is undermining how our students view each other and themselves (either as an oppressor or as the oppressed) and is churning out young adults that hate their country and its institutions. However, while most recent headlines have been about CRT in education, such Marxist ideologies are in more than that. They are infiltrating our healthcare system as well. CRT under the guise of "antiracist medicine" and "health equity" is transforming healthcare away from a science- and patient-oriented endeavor to an activist opportunity to "level the playing field." Its claim: any and all racial health disparities are caused - by racism - and not lifestyle choices. Already, this racially-preferential heathcare is ==, enabling medical practitioners to consider race as a risk factor when allocating scarce COVID-19 treatments and so prioritizing the medical treatment of non-white patients over white patients. So, where are we seeing this? Let's look. As of January 1, under new Department of Health and Human Services guidelines, the Biden administration is paying bonuses to physicians who acknowledge systemic racism as the primary cause of health differences between racial groups. Medical professionals have advocated for prioritizing black and Latino patients when rationing limited, life-saving medical resources. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) prioritized vaccines for essential workers over the elderly since demographically, the elderly are more white, and essential workers tend be less white. This happened regardless of the well-documented fact that the elderly are of the highest risk for contracting and dying from COVID-19. Vermont granted vaccine priority to non-white households prior to deeming the general public eligible for vaccination. A Boston hospital advocated to base admissions for cardiological services on race (black and Latino). The University of Pennsylvania medical school pushed to have race accounted for when rationing ventilators. * In Houston this past December, on their appointment form for monoclonal antibodies treatment, an urgent care facility included race (black/Hispanic) as one of the determining factors for prioritizing treatment. It's insane that I even have to say this, but all people should be given the same priority, treatment, and care regardless of their skin color. But, this is where we are now, and this is the evil we are battling against. We need representation in Congress that will actively stand against and defeat these insidious ideologies and policies. | Dear Neighbor,
This week, in an effort to bolster support for military intervention in Ukraine, Biden's Deputy National Security Adviser said Americans should care about Ukraine because "borders should be inviolate....sovereignty should be respected."
Is this a joke? Ukraine's borders and sovereignty? What about our own?
Under the Biden Administration we have experienced:

* The federal government covertly [transporting illegal immigrants](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001IRJUtUO1wyR6_ZU6ZEF_PUdfdoqo8qUylPcNxvvN0t5jQ8Ihdb9ZlasgAeOvglA2RDU_w5iY7sZEHlkPE7uK9Y_wCEXxGa6rHVWRCKlKyvs4vTC16Gpghb6tyL3k5O-70cjKEAicA4tEyAV9wmayEX22S7v9Eb-NjxlqD0uGS2-asfoTlXQHvG1CBSdQU3LjwejyAVMJnVBhr4jp9ypNFspUTXMtZkj-eD5_SKeeTt0=&c=w4kaKuxugr9mv1KttCzTkD2LuQwLvXnB4dYneIjKsotDJsp5EOlu8A==&ch=0OXiwf071N8RogBhSJbVZruojcTdQ44miL1ReoYHrxPAzuR1fsEQIA==) from southern border states to cities across the country
* A 1,000% surge (in some border sectors) in the the number of migrants infected with COVID-19
* Almost 2 million illegal border crossings at the US-Mexico border in the first seven months of 2021
* Twelve Texas counties declaring emergencies (May 2021) due to the border crisis and the increase in illegal crossings and human trafficking
* An ongoing decrease in the support and provisioning of our border and ICE agents.

Living in Texas, we know first-hand the importance of having a secure border. We know that a country without borders isn't a country. It is vulnerable and weak, rather than secure and strong. We must secure our border, stopping the flow of illegal immigration, crime, and human trafficking that is pouring across it. This isn't uncaring or inhumane. It's common sense.
I am for finishing the wall, provisioning our border and ICE agents with the tools to do their jobs, implementing harsher punishments on human traffickers, and deporting all violent criminals.
We are a sovereign nation. We must act like one. We must secure and protect our border.
---
Fellow Texans, the fight for our country is now, and this 2022 election is our opportunity to elect true, conservative, and common sense candidates who will provide solutions to our crisis at the border.
Send me to Washington. I will fight for America and her sovereignty.

body:
I'm depending on your grassroots support to power this historic campaign and help me fight back against the GOP's attacks.
| | |
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41271086/328064681/1498072919?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1622-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZmNlMTg4YS1hZjgyLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KzBpy7CzOlYrUggdmf8tKc22TvVYEtYWeE05hCD48yI=) Friend,

That's me you're looking at.

I grew up poor in the segregated South, the daughter of a maid and a janitor. If you had told me back then, as a young Black girl, that I would become the first in my family to graduate college, the first woman to lead the Orlando Police Department, a congresswoman and a candidate for U.S. Senate, well – I just don't know if I would have believed you. What I _did_ __ believe then – and what I carry deep in my soul to this day – is the lesson of my hardworking parents to "never tire of doing good." It was my parents' words that inspired me to get into public service. It was their words that have driven me to do good every chance I get. From my time as a young social worker to my career as a law enforcement officer to being a representative of my community in Congress – "never tire" is a mantra that I've held dear. **My unlikely story of opportunity is proof of what is possible and what should be possible for every American.** As Florida's next U.S. senator, I will _never tire_ in the work to make sure the greatness of America is accessible and affordable for all Americans. I will _never tire_ in continuing to do more good for you and your family. But when it comes to this race, the GOP won't tire either: **The Republican National Committee chair is already attacking me personally, while Mitch McConnell and GOP outside groups are ready to dump tens of MILLIONS into Florida to defeat me.** This is already shaping up to be the most expensive Senate election _ever_ – and with just a .12% margin in Florida's last Senate race, every dollar will count tremendously. I know a thing or two about winning tough races, but I need your help because I can't do this alone. **I'm depending on your grassroots support to power this historic campaign and help me fight back against the GOP's attacks – and right now, I'm falling short of my midnight goal.[Will you split a donation of $5 or more today between my campaign and Jacky Rosen's to make sure we have the resources to defeat Marco Rubio and protect and expand Democratic Senate control?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41271087/328064682/1498072919?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1622-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZmNlMTg4YS1hZjgyLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KzBpy7CzOlYrUggdmf8tKc22TvVYEtYWeE05hCD48yI=)** Thank you so much for sharing this journey with me. It means the world to have you by my side.

Val Demings

| Peter,

Tonight at midnight is the January end-of-month deadline, and we only need 21 contributions to meet our 250 donor goal.

**That 's why I'm humbly asking for your support -- will you please pitch in to our campaign before the clock strikes midnight tonight? This campaign will not be easy -- we have a long road ahead before we reach election day. I need to continue to get to know people around the district who do not yet know me and work to gain their support. And in the months ahead, we need an organized and concerted advertising effort to get our message in front of voters. But while looking ahead may feel daunting sometimes, I am more motivated than ever.

The support you've shown me so far pushes me to keep working harder to win this race. I'm honored that so many people have supported my campaign by following along on social media, talking to their friends about my candidacy, or becoming grassroots donors of our movement.

I couldn't do this without you, Peter, and I look forward to continuing to accomplish every goal we set during this campaign. But now, I am asking for your support one final time before the month ends.

The Republicans in our state are trying to stack the deck to give themselves the best shot at staying in power. This cannot wait, we must do everything in our power to fight back against this blatant gerrymandering.

are you ready to join in? | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/0d38174ddb41/it-comes-down-to-tomorrow?e=33b11688c1)
---
| |
---
| | Peter,

Life won't return to normal unless Tim Walz is out of office. He's made criminals out of honest, every-day Minnesotans with his Cuomo-style lockdown policies and he's let real criminals roam free.

Instead, imagine having a governor who values education centered around students, supports law enforcement and safety in the streets, creates a competitive and thriving economic climate for families and small businesses, expands our fundamental rights like free speech and the right to bear arms, and restores health freedom and privacy. It _can_ happen! But we need to pick the best candidate who can _win_ and champion those values. _That starts tomorrow night at your precinct caucus_.

**[Find your caucus location now](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=833a09cf7c&e=33b11688c1) and show up at 7 PM tomorrow!**

Please, do everything you can to **be there** , say **"I want to be a delegate"** , and **vote for us in the Straw Poll**!

_Are you undecided?_ Let me help. We have campaigned for nearly a year and are best positioned to take on Tim Walz and the DFL machine in November.
1. **We set a small dollar fundraising record in 2021**. We have energized Minnesotans from all over the state. No Republican or Democrat has built the war chest as a challenger in the off year like we have. _This matters_ because Tim Walz will have an immense amount of money to control the message. We're the only campaign that's built this grassroots army.
2. **I stood in the breach and haven't flinched.** The medical and political establishment tried to take my medical license 5 times because I challenged Tim Walz's one-size-fits-all COVID policies. I've built clinics, started businesses, witnessed first-hand the dysfunction in St. Paul, and had my livelihood threatened for my stances. I haven't blinked and I won't blink as your governor. I'll be an advocate for Minnesotans like I've been for my patients. I don't just talk about fighting this creeping authoritarianism; I've lived it.
3. **We're expanding the conservative tent.** We are making the case for conservative values in places where Republicans haven't before. From the Iron Range, to the suburbs, to North Minneapolis and beyond, people are coming into the Republican fold who haven't before! We will win because we're creating a movement.
4. **The DFL fears our campaign most. **We have been attacked relentlessly already by Tim Walz and the Democrat machine. They know we're unpredictable and creating a groundswell movement never-before-seen in Minnesota. [We have generated massive interest at events and rallies](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=0dd41c7329&e=33b11688c1) and have built recognition across the state!
5. **I will be a leader for our conservative movement.** From ending lockdowns and vaccine mandates, to advocating for parental rights in health choices and education, to protecting our fundamental freedoms, I have led on the issues - even as my career was threatened. We can win as Republicans, but only if we have a candidate who has broad appeal and speaks boldly even when it comes at a cost. I will be that candidate.

With your participation tomorrow, we can take the first step in returning to normal and getting back on the right path. If Tim Walz remains governor, I fear we will not have a state worth leaving to our kids and grandkids. We will not return to normal if he is re-elected in November. Let's nominate a candidate who can win and fight for us! [Show up and participate in your caucus!](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=48fff0c793&e=33b11688c1)

I need you, but most importantly: Minnesota needs you. Remember the words within Esther 4:14. We have all been called "for such a time as this".

Let's win and take back our state.

In Freedom,

Dr. Scott Jensen
Republican Candidate for Governor - Minnesota

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: We're suing twitter and we need your help
body:
I’m not going to beat around the bush... we are living in a dystopian, tyrannical state.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zlpfrvie3cckpuvaa2j69dvbqig5safn3sdildng_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37c9l6cqj7djl6eqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbr76tpmehjj9p9lc1g6cp3kejirap35mdi72tphehim0pb5mhhrcpjim9qbcpj0cv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj66lhb6or0e8omccbgmmq6fc5lclp238h1e8he4933c5j66pb4cthm1oh5u)
[](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-ADN&utm_content=adn) Dear Fellow Conservative, I’m not going to beat around the bush... we are living in a dystopian, tyrannical state. My team at the Center for American Liberty has recently uncovered evidence of powerful elected politicians colluding with Big Tech corporations like Facebook and Twitter to de-platform and silence conservatives like you and me. **In other words, we’ve caught big government using tax-payer funding to silence their political opponents.** And if someone does not immediately stand up against this, the freedoms enshrined in our Constitution will become nothing more than meaningless words on a piece of paper. That’s why we launched a lawsuit against Twitter, U.S. Senator Alex Padilla, and a handful of liberal elected officials for their state-sponsored plot to eliminate our First Amendment liberties – _and we need your help to win._ **[Will you join us in our lawsuit against Twitter and Sen. Padilla and help defend the First Amendment?](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-ADN&utm_content=adn)** Let me explain... Like millions of Americans after the 2020 presidential election, conservative activist Rogan O’Handley took to Twitter to express his concerns about the dubious election procedures and skepticism of the results. [](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-ADN&utm_content=adn) [](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-ADN&utm_content=adn) [](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-ADN&utm_content=adn) Shortly after the election, many of Rogan's tweets were removed by Twitter and his account was permanently suspended for “violating the government’s rules about election integrity.” _Hopefully, I don’t need to explain to you that censoring or de-platforming ANY American for their political beliefs or opinions is a gross violation of the First Amendment._ But it gets much worse... When Rogan tried to figure out why he was censored, he found that bureaucrats working for then-California Secretary of State, Alex Padilla, had explicitly instructed officials at Twitter to silence him. You see, Alex Padilla was being considered to fill Kamala Harris’ vacated seat in the U.S. Senate – and he was afraid that Rogan’s tweets would hurt his image and chances of being appointed. **So, the office of Alex Padilla immediately instructed his press secretary to contact Twitter and shut Rogan up.** **From:** California Secretary of State Communications Department **To:** Twitter **Date:** Tuesday, November 17th, 2020 at 12:31 PM Hi, We wanted to flag this Twitter post: [](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-ADN&utm_content=adn) From user @DC_Draino. In this post user claims California of being a culprit of voter fraud, and ignores the fact that we do audit votes. This is a blatant disregard to how our voting process works and creates disinformation and distrust among the general public. Twitter then flagged the post as misinformation, deleted it, and -- a few weeks later -- permanently banned Rogan from the their site. [](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-ADN&utm_content=adn) That’s why my team and I at the Center for America Liberty are suing Twitter, now-Senator Alex Padilla, California Secretary of State Shirly Weber, and a handful of other liberals for their involvement in this blatant assault on the First Amendment. subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vW_ukXWHNh

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only
take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives-but
supported by many well-meaning Americans-to change the way we
elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the
Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oW_ukXWHNh

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent
matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but
the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by
progressives-but supported by many well-meaning Americans-to
change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do
away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our
Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a
National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to
me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more
clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning
this issue-views we will make available to policymakers and
opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on
Presidential Selection by using the link below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey

For most of our nation's history, the
Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution,
was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to
preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have
joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional
bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution
has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to
provide young people with a proper grounding in American
civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the importance
of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has
expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide,
directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the
Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide
through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The
Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over 5.6 million households and
businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of
liberty;

Promoting constitutional education
through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of
America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across
America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education
through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which
launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools
nationwide.

Your answers to the National Survey on
Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most
effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the
importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this
critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent
topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection
and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a
few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure
link I've provided below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey

And after you take your survey, I hope you
will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing
truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its
extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is
essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the
National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for
your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of
liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

body:
He would step down and take Kamala Harris with him because he’s created a foreign policy disaster that is beyond dangerous.
& nbsp; &nb; sp;
Not interested? [Unsubscribe Here](https://trk.cp20.com/form?3ehp0--fgxr-4qqlpo5&sl=2d&t=5&ac=gh7s)
| | | [](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-3ehp0-1vtlx-4qqlpo2/)
---

Fellow Conservative.

If Biden loved our country, he would step down and take Kamala Harris with him because he’s created a foreign policy disaster that is beyond dangerous.

And, when you don’t have a strong America, you don’t have a safe world..._And that’s what’s on the cusp of happening._

**[Will you rush a donation to fight back and elect strong conservatives right away?](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-3ehp0-1vtly-4qqlpo3/ "Will you rush a donation to fight back and elect strong conservatives right away? ")**

My only hope and prayer is that the Biden administration gets its act together and realizes that this is about all of us.

This is about safety. This is about strength. This is about freedom winning.

**We are in a dangerous situation.** Biden destroyed Afghanistan. He’s put us in a weak position with Russia. He has no plan for Taiwan, and he’s sending our athletes over to Beijing for the Olympics without a plan for how he’s going to protect them when they’re over there.

Our athletes have been threatened and told they will be punished if they speak out against the Chinese government.

_**Where’s the protection for Americans? Where’s the leadership?**_

Biden has failed on every level.

---
| [](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-3ehp0-1vtlz-4qqlpo4/)
---

Then you look at the domestic issues. Look at the crime hitting our streets. Look at an entire COVID generation that is struggling educationally and we’ll be lucky if they graduate from high school at this point if we keep these schools closed and keep giving in to the teachers unions. Look at the border where Biden allowed 200,000 illegal immigrants to cross last month alone.

**Biden’s failures are a danger to our country.** Unless he steps down, we’re stuck with this administration for another two years. We already have full Democrat control in the House and Senate, and now it’s likely that another liberal Supreme Court justice is about to be nominated.

**[If Biden doesn’t step down, there’s just one other way to stop his harmful agenda – by taking back our Republican majorities in the House and Senate.](https://trk.cp20.com/click/gh7s-3ehp0-1vtm0-4qqlpo1/ "If Biden doesn’t step down, there’s just one other way to stop his harmful agenda – by taking back our Republican majorities in the House and Senate. ")**

My team at the Center for American Liberty has recently uncovered evidence of powerful elected politicians colluding with Big Tech corporations like Facebook and Twitter to de-platform and silence conservatives like you and me. **In other words, we’ve caught big government using tax-payer funding to silence their political opponents.** And if someone does not immediately stand up against this, the freedoms enshrined in our Constitution will become nothing more than meaningless words on a piece of paper. That’s why we launched a lawsuit against Twitter, U.S. Senator Alex Padilla, and a handful of liberal elected officials for their state-sponsored plot to eliminate our First Amendment liberties – _and we need your help to win._ **[Will you join us in our lawsuit against Twitter and Sen. Padilla and help defend the First Amendment?](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-TTN&utm_content=ttn)** Let me explain... Like millions of Americans after the 2020 presidential election, conservative activist Rogan O’Handley took to Twitter to express his concerns about the dubious election procedures and skepticism of the results. [](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-TTN&utm_content=ttn) [](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-TTN&utm_content=ttn) [](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-TTN&utm_content=ttn) Shortly after the election, many of Rogan's tweets were removed by Twitter and his account was permanently suspended for “violating the government’s rules about election integrity.” _Hopefully, I don’t need to explain to you that censoring or de-platforming ANY American for their political beliefs or opinions is a gross violation of the First Amendment._ But it gets much worse... Twitter then flagged the post as misinformation, deleted it, and -- a few weeks later -- permanently banned Rogan from the their site. [](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-TTN&utm_content=ttn) That’s why my team and I at the Center for America Liberty are suing Twitter, now-Senator Alex Padilla, California Secretary of State Shirly Weber, and a handful of other liberals for their involvement in this blatant assault on the First Amendment. Two years ago, I founded the Center for American Liberty with the purpose of protecting our First Amendment freedoms and civil liberties from being destroyed by today’s left. We’ve taken on Governor Gavin Newsom in California when he unconstitutionally shut down small businesses, banned people from going to church, and kept millions of children locked up in their homes—out of school—during the pandemic. Alex Padilla, and others for colluding to eliminate Rogan O’Handley’s freedom of speech.** But as a non-profit organization, everything we do to defend our civil liberties is with the generous help of like-minded conservative patriots like you. But now that there is clear evidence that a California elected official colluded with big tech to censor conservatives who wanted to comment on the 2020 election those same leftists are dead-silent. I am absolutely fed up with left’s hypocrisy, double-standards, and blatantly unconstitutional behavior. [**That’s why I’m urgently asking you to contribute $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty to help us fund our lawsuit against Twitter and Senator Alex Padilla. **](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-TTN&utm_content=ttn) [**DONATE**](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-TTN&utm_content=ttn) [](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-TTN&utm_content=ttn) [Please consider supporting our efforts to defend our Constitution with a donation today.](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-TTN&utm_content=ttn) The Center For American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization created to fight against growing anti-free-speech and anti-civil liberties trends.

subject: New year, new district
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Salud Carbajal for Congress
body:
[](https://act.myngp.com/el/h448NxFm0QM9cHWBldSNDopwZkxDe7SlPSoO0aRh85I=/yH8hC90pvhc0bASjZsA9rzDWFRn0PwYacGeUpgoHHJE=?am=&recipientId=cDmLEpJFmDvVxlWX7upKG1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com)
As the first month of 2022 draws to a close, I wanted to provide a quick update about the new Congressional district I'll be running in and what we can expect our campaign to look like this year.
The new 24th district lines shift south, and I am excited to have the opportunity to represent new communities in Ventura County, including the cities of Ojai and Ventura. I will continue to represent southern San Luis Obispo County, including the City of San Luis Obispo, and all of Santa Barbara County.
As you know, our first contest this year is the June 7 Primary. That means we have less than 6 months to meet over 120,000 new voters who have never seen my name on their ballot before. I have always relied on volunteer-driven, grassroots campaigns, and this year will be no different. We are busy organizing and preparing our field campaign, and look forward spending the next few months connecting with new voters and re-connecting with those who I currently have the privilege of representing.
Of course, this new district means our field operation will need to increase significantly. We will be working out of three counties instead of two, and, needless to say, this expansion means we must increase our budget.
[**_Will you chip in today to help us fund our expanded field campaign?_**](https://act.myngp.com/el/h448NxFm0QM9cHWBldSNDopwZkxDe7SlPSoO0aRh85I=/yH8hC90pvhc0bASjZsA9rzDWFRn0PwYacGeUpgoHHJE=?am=&recipientId=cDmLEpJFmDvVxlWX7upKG1&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com)
I am optimistic about the new year and the changes and opportunities it will bring. I look forward to staying in touch with you and seeing you on the campaign trail. We Democrats know we have a lot of work to do to keep our Majority this fall, but, with help from supporters like you, I am confident we will have the resources we need to connect with every voter and run a strong campaign in 2022.
Best wishes for the new year and thank you again for your support.
Sincerely,
Salud Carbajal

For the first time since the Civil War, one major party is actively working to undermine our democratic process. And I'm not just talking about January 6th and the Trump insurrectionists. I’m talking about the 19 GOP-controlled states that are enacting laws to make it harder to cast votes and allowing partisans to interfere with the vote count. And about what we just saw one week ago when EVERY SINGLE Republican Senator voted to use the current filibuster rule to prevent a majority vote on the Freedom to Vote and John Lewis Voting Rights bills.
**And something else is different — the enormous influence of secret money in our elections.** America's billionaires are altogether worth over $5 trillion today. And under our current campaign finance laws, any one of them can give UNLIMITED secret money to shadowy groups trying to defeat elected officials they disagree with.

Today, Greg was endorsed by Representative Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez! Rep. AOC inspired the nation with her bold, progressive campaign in 2018, and has continued to fight for working families across the country since taking office. Now she’s proudly supporting Greg’s campaign ahead of the March 1st primary—and you can join her!
Can you join Rep. AOC in supporting Greg’s campaign? With less than two weeks until early voting starts, we need your support now more than ever! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/greg-casar-for-congress-aoc?refcode=01.31email]

Leaders like Rep. AOC know that for these families to thrive, they need champions in Congress who will fight for them every day. That’s what Rep. AOC has done and that’s what Greg will do when he’s elected.
We’re so honored and excited to have AOC’s support—and we hope you’ll join her in supporting Greg’s campaign in this final stretch before the March 1st primary. Can you join Rep. It’s time to suit up, Peter.

**I'm John James, and I’m running for Congress here in Michigan, and I need you as my Co-Pilot.**

I swore an oath to support and defend the Constitution, and now we’re facing one of its greatest threats in our lifetime.
_**Faith. Family. Service. The American Dream.**_
These core tenants have always guided the American way of life, **and each one of them is at risk with our current leadership in government:**
❌ The DOJ weaponized against concerned parents for opposing critical race theory.
❌ Washington serving their own interests while abandoning our servicemen and women.
❌ Inflation and out-of-control spending are making the American Dream just that, a distant dream.
**Peter, I gave this speech at CPAC 2020 about my own family’s journey through the American Dream:**
[](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9679143cb3524b99b2e8737b0b1f9407&_e=rQ4MycSt6DXZ_rwAZYV4EcYz28d9WPGPHQ94ZE6ZEy3OLEcTCeT2-MAX6DIyX6mwbAgYfhkQLy1EVnlyuVKea0u84ueX_AXwOKrbnKl-N9wkM5kd9324bUetKA6rKWgvGiSHj3yJtNtl6fVp7zWHFhLuyJN-0PXcBZrWs4Fq5wjib5UzVVl_VtlTu-ys_xJjGJuAEEAln9mLyr7E4XtrsSQJ8trrcSEK-hHwcZEFn-mLJUWAzd3Mr3XfDL88YmyklTWRtRvJLDV-GJ154_ylhSuZiHUkqpVIMxk07jAyC9OyOuDRpfm1_PkAzWFdwqoiLjUHFvRY9aXpJrMM8ew0ShvYLW5lT4vpU1d637YyuKIY5jGm_mjp-VggxuLpFtINtghMu2K_Pu8zj8hZY0ftUvbbBD0JBjf0KUt8exnftJ4%3D)
**We’re rapidly approaching an America where this won’t be true anymore, where the American Dream will be nothing more than a myth, and _where the only people who prosper are wealthy elites._**

We are at what President Reagan called _‘A Time for Choosing,’_ and we as a nation must choose which path we wish to follow.

**_I choose exceptionalism over entitlement... _**

**_I choose achievement over apathy..._**

**_I choose freedom over socialism..._**

**I refuse to let the American Dream die with our generationーI know the stakes are high, but I put my oath to protect our Republic above all else.**
**_
Now, I’m asking you to send me to Congress to do just that by investing a ‘Day 1 Donation’ towards my fight—[are you ready to fly?](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=9679143cb3524b99b2e8737b0b1f9407&_e=rQ4MycSt6DXZ_rwAZYV4EcYz28d9WPGPHQ94ZE6ZEy3OLEcTCeT2-MAX6DIyX6mwbAgYfhkQLy1EVnlyuVKea0u84ueX_AXwOKrbnKl-N9wkM5kd9324bUetKA6rKWgvGiSHj3yJtNtl6fVp7zWHFhLuyJN-0PXcBZrWs4Fq5wjib5UzVVl_VtlTu-ys_xJjGJuAEEAln9mLyr7E4XtrsUsEH2ncTfXiexG3zNu1cRaEZ1lyTvnKb3S6kehqeDkkBhJpzT35QQCA63ihykbuy3-BBpdFCJxEXdrlFJlx4YcfI4Uf7jl4wnce4N9NPR1Mzw2gyowST2qtVpO5iVwGTwL6KJ4x4V48CWfiPJNy2r-1lbEuC0NnYrud_wJ1CPPSHibXct2p36wRw_pI1eUP9Gd8OiWGnw2N7DMiSnf-Qz8%3D)

body:
Ohio deserves better.

Team,
Years ago, before I ever considered running for office, a representative from EMILY’s List reached out to urge me to run for Congress. They told me I’d be a great representative – and also, that I just needed to raise $1 million.
They might as well have told me that I just needed to go to the moon. I grew up in a working class, union family. I couldn’t raise $1 million from friends and family and I certainly couldn’t self-fund my campaign.
However, that conversation inspired me to run for Dayton’s city commission instead. I discovered that I love working to help our communities thrive – but I still hate asking for money.
**[I have to ask though, because we’re facing a reporting deadline today that’s the biggest test of our campaign yet, and we’re still a bit short of our $25,000 goal. Can you contribute $5 right now to flip Ohio?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41279776/328103247/399792850?refcode=nw_em_220131_2_t2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NmVmZTc0MC1jODgyLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Wg-PlDGr_SQAIa3dcS38LKQvWzpql2FgrpUzDFZHLs8=)**
For the last 30 years, our state has been governed by the same corrupt crew. They’ve watched as costs for working families rose while good-paying jobs got harder to find, and all the while they let our communities struggle while enriching themselves and their special interest allies.
Enough. Ohio deserves better.
I’m the only non-millionaire candidate in this race and I’m running to support Ohio families like mine. I believe that together, we can create good-paying jobs, raise wages and lower costs, so that our young people don’t feel forced to leave the state in search of opportunity.
**[But first, I need your support. Can you contribute $5 before today’s deadline to create a new chapter for Ohio?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41279778/328103249/399792850?refcode=nw_em_220131_2_t2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NmVmZTc0MC1jODgyLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Wg-PlDGr_SQAIa3dcS38LKQvWzpql2FgrpUzDFZHLs8=)**

clean_body: Ohio deserves better. Team, Years ago, before I ever considered running for office, a representative from EMILY’s List reached out to urge me to run for Congress. They told me I’d be a great representative – and also, that I just needed to raise $1 million. They might as well have told me that I just needed to go to the moon. I grew up in a working class, union family. I couldn’t raise $1 million from friends and family and I certainly couldn’t self-fund my campaign. However, that conversation inspired me to run for Dayton’s city commission instead. I discovered that I love working to help our communities thrive – but I still hate asking for money. = For the last 30 years, our state has been governed by the same corrupt crew. They’ve watched as costs for working families rose while good-paying jobs got harder to find, and all the while they let our communities struggle while enriching themselves and their special interest allies. Enough. Ohio deserves better. I’m the only non-millionaire candidate in this race and I’m running to support Ohio families like mine. I believe that together, we can create good-paying jobs, raise wages and lower costs, so that our young people don’t feel forced to leave the state in search of opportunity. = Onwards, Nan **= Paid for by Friends of Nan Whaley PO Box 2815, Dayton, OH 45401 This campaign is powered by supporters like you, but if you'd like to unsubscribe, .

And all along the way, we have to hit a series of deadline goals to keep pace. Tonight is one of those deadlines, and we’re not at our goals just yet.

As the pandemic has shown, we need plans that will ensure our health and safety — careful plans that are patiently developed and refined, day by day, out of the spotlight. We need road-tested plans that are ready to roll out even when no one is sick, even when wildfires aren’t raging and hurricanes aren’t blowing in, even when our economy isn’t on the brink of collapse. Hey Friends,

You’re probably getting tons of emails since it’s a Monday afternoon and also the end of the month, so there’s a good chance you might not even see this one or read through it. **[You can totally skip through my rant below and make a contribution here if you’re already down to help us hit our critical end-of-month goal.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41281571/328111067/-1288899752?refcode=220131_FR_eom3jessica_L1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTM0OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5ODI0MzdhZi1jZTgyLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=i6ZZ4AWi1XPatdwdIWjHpgLnCaTAKxHTMpreRwElBE8=)** _But if you need a bit more convincing, here’s some more detail on why I’m running for Congress:_

**Dark money, special interests, and corruption hold far too much power.** Policy decisions in Washington aren’t made in the best interest of everyday people but driven by corporate greed.

**Meanwhile, SO many Americans are barely getting by.** They can’t afford rent and are getting evicted from their homes. Their rural communities lack reliable internet. They are saddled with student loan debt. Greenhouse gas emissions are polluting their air, water, and food supply. They are getting sick during a _literal global pandemic_ and cannot receive or access healthcare.

I could tell you more about my own lived experiences — about growing up in a poor Black neighborhood in Dallas, about my chronic respiratory illness, about my service in the Navy, about my work in affordable housing, and so on...

But I’m not going to do that right now because although this fight is extremely personal for me, it’s also much bigger than me. These struggles are all too common, **_and yet nothing has been done about it._**

We deserve so much better than broken promises and political talking points. It’s time for a working-class agenda with bold solutions. It’s time for leaders who are brave enough to stand up and refuse to accept the status quo — or to let the corporate-backed machine overpower the will of the people.

**It’s time for a New Deal.**

**_That’s_ why I’m running for Congress and refusing to accept any corporate PAC money so that I’m ONLY accountable to YOU, friends.**

**[But today, I urgently need to ask for your support because MIDNIGHT is our final end-of-month deadline before early voting officially begins, and we need to raise $5,814 to hit our goal on time. Policy decisions in Washington aren’t made in the best interest of everyday people but driven by corporate greed. Meanwhile, SO many Americans are barely getting by. They can’t afford rent and are getting evicted from their homes. Their rural communities lack reliable internet. They are saddled with student loan debt. Greenhouse gas emissions are polluting their air, water, and food supply. They are getting sick during a literal global pandemic and cannot receive or access healthcare. I could tell you more about my own lived experiences — about growing up in a poor Black neighborhood in Dallas, about my chronic respiratory illness, about my service in the Navy, about my work in affordable housing, and so on... But I’m not going to do that right now because although this fight is extremely personal for me, it’s also much bigger than me. These struggles are all too common, and yet nothing has been done about it. We deserve so much better than broken promises and political talking points. It’s time for a working-class agenda with bold solutions. It’s time for leaders who are brave enough to stand up and refuse to accept the status quo — or to let the corporate-backed machine overpower the will of the people. It’s time for a New Deal. | _**ABOUT ROD**_

Rod Dorilás is the first-generation son of two immigrants from Haiti. His father immigrated to Florida to pick crops, and eventually his parents went on to own a small business. From a young age, his parents instilled in him the importance of hard work, integrity, and service.

At age 17, Rod enlisted in the United States Navy, serving for six years as a Petty Officer Second Class and Assistant Engagement Control Officer onboard the USS The Sullivans, stationed in Jacksonville. There, he was responsible for planning and executing the deployment of Tomahawk Land Attack Missiles on the Ballistic Missile Defense destroyer.

Upon completion of his military service, Rod attended law school at Syracuse University with the help of the G.I. Bill. After graduating, he served in President Trump's Administration in the U.S. Department of Commerce. While serving our great nation, Rod fought tirelessly to ensure that American families and businesses weren't taken advantage of by China.

Rod is a true public servant and is dedicated to serving his country and community. He wants to ensure that every American, through hard work and perseverance, can achieve the American Dream. Rod is running for Congress in South Florida to continue Trump's America First Agenda and defend our country from the Radical Left.

name: Erika Benfield
subject: RELEASE: Erika Benfield Announces "Gun Owners for Erika" Coalition
body:
---
| | | | | |
---
|
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE: January 31, 2022
---
| Contact: Derek Dufresne press@erikabenfieldforcongress.com; 202-809-6013
---
| Erika Benfield Announces "Gun Owners for Erika" Coalition
---
|
---
| Lake Mary, FL - Erika Benfield, candidate for Congress, announced the launch of the Gun Owners for Erika Coalition, backed by gun owners and 2nd Amendment supporters across Central Florida.
---
| Erika Benfield made the following statement in response to releasing her Gun Owners for Erika Coalition:
"I am proud to officially announce the launch of the Gun Owners for Erika Coalition. This group is filled with gun owners, like myself, who cherish our God-given right to bear arms and protect ourselves.
"As conservatives, we recognize the brilliance of the Founding Fathers and the importance of the Constitution. The 2nd Amendment clearly states that 'the right of the people to keep and bear arms shall not be infringed.' Meanwhile, the radical Left thinks they can strip us of our rights and take away our guns. Well, I can assure you that when I am elected to Congress, I will contest and put a stop to any attempts by the far-Left to try and restrict or manipulate our gun rights.
"I'm honored to have this coalition supporting me in my campaign for Congress, and I pledge to always support and uphold our 2nd Amendment rights when I am elected as your next representative."
---
| The Gun Owners for Erika Coalition has released the following statements:
Debbie Zimmerman, Former Congressional Chief of Staff, Founder of South Florida Firearms Owners & Tropical Sport Shooting Association, Geneva, FL "Erika will stand for our Second Amendment rights, and you can trust she will never give one inch to the 'woke' Democrat gun grabbers. She and I are gun owners and advocate for training and practice at Florida's awesome gun ranges. So, let's all aim to get Erika Benfield elected to Congress!"
Yorelis Navas, 2nd Amendment Advocate, Deltona, FL "Erika has supported local gun shops during her term on the city council. She promotes women to carry and has even met my husband to pick out a holster for my Christmas gift. I have gone shooting at a gun range with Erika, and I know her well. She is supportive of women exercising their 2A rights, and that's one of the many reasons I support her."
Gio Arcelay, 2nd Amendment Advocate, Deltona, FL "I am an Army veteran, paratrooper, I have gone shooting with Erika, and we both have concealed weapons permit in Florida. I have no doubt she is pro-gun and enjoys exercising her Second Amendment right."
Other members of the Gun Owners for Erika Coalition include:
* John Eynouf, Paladin Response Fire Arms Instructor, Lake Mary, FL
* Francisco "Frank" & Iranis De La Torre, Fat Firearms LLC, Deland, FL
* "Hip" Hipolito Rosado & wife, Norma, Shooters World Instructor, Apopka, FL
* Anthony Narvaez, Shooters World Instructor, Orlando, FL
* Sherry Meyers, Shooting w/ Sherry Instructor Volusia County Gun and Hunt Club, Port Orange, FL
* Sharie Spironhi, Owner of Bullseye Virtual Training, Port Orange, FL
* David Beane, Retired Security Lieutenant Department of Corrections NY, DeBary, FL
* Eric Nompleggi, 2nd Amendment Advocate, Deland, FL
* Tommy Schaeffer, 2nd Amendment Advocate, DeBary, FL
* Jeff Ward, 2nd Amendment Advocate, DeBary, FL
* Paul Benfield, USCCA Delta Defense AE, DeBary, FL

---
| This is the 4th coalition of many to be released in the coming months in addition to the other local endorsements Erika has earned thus far from other community leaders and local officials, such as Volusia County Sheriff [Mike Chitwood](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LymmGfMbM3t4imyhYo0wN1dDQH67-9Voyi-dv5YpAjy4d6TMZOlCysomBGVjot4CKIy7NDfcpxMfKAurOSx8Bz5LSslLK-W1WcjrkoJYRXd6SHOYrtkUUgZ7U4QV8XSWRkmCs2s5moia7c9DDYT_ni_2TA67nfjjMjX_H3m7etVDT0gYzySaLA1rV1tVDqUz8bIRV-IkPjWjFktwOPO8bobctuGlXrqkVs3daaXtgn18w_Sx08hBhiACsCc9vDmLV6SSpY0NFvo=&c=rovs9lrg7eNkJ2jNJV9Zv5OgpbAcri6RcfV6UVoCoV-Q1FXLDcvXkg==&ch=wfJVO_bxfQ_e1jD4T9nHtTFZLh96Pdz0pXKnxkV9jKNMGYbCBB9HRA==) and Former State Representative [Bob Cortes](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001LymmGfMbM3t4imyhYo0wN1dDQH67-9Voyi-dv5YpAjy4d6TMZOlCysomBGVjot4CjQElnNO-FkOHf9Jz3_TOGm1DyIYGPQDVu0T8nR54Gfke7JslYomVuttlzxrcjJ5psibjMxZ7XT9CTl1wEWkEg0A4o8_zrkGtUBm00BNmWsFJPxhDfDbpjgXatdD0jz0sVCqQF6iFnzOm0Gou04L98hkWZDMaCqgcCbjVunUkHH1iEtpGeLH9J5BipwbdEEfYBuA6nUWX228=&c=rovs9lrg7eNkJ2jNJV9Zv5OgpbAcri6RcfV6UVoCoV-Q1FXLDcvXkg==&ch=wfJVO_bxfQ_e1jD4T9nHtTFZLh96Pdz0pXKnxkV9jKNMGYbCBB9HRA==).

body:
Stop the RINOs from starting another war | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/neilforarkansas/jan6-5066125?e=eda539b26b)
---
| | [ ](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=4e7cbfc693&e=eda539b26b)
---
| | Fellow Patriot:

Are you ready for World War III?

I’m not. **And I know you’re not either.**

But my warmonger opponent, along with most of the corrupt Republican and Democrat Uniparty Establishment, is cheerleading for a war with Russia over the Ukraine.

Some of these America Last Neocons have even talked about a nuclear strike! Pure insanity.

_These same RINOs are willing to send your children—and your hard-earned money—to die for Ukraine’s borders,_while they totally ignore the invasion at our own Southern Border!__

For 20 years, our Middle Eastern wars bled our nation dry, killed tens of thousands of our best and brightest young Americans, and enriched nobody but the bankers and defense contractors who bribe our politicians.

These very same defense contractors—evil corporate special interests like Raytheon, fueled by American misery—are the ones bankrolling my opponent’s $2 million war chest.

The military-industrial complex, which serves every interest in the world except our own, makes up a large portion of my opponent’s donors.

This blood money keeps our fat cat politicians rich, and keeps those politicians sending our boys to die in wars that don’t serve American interests one bit.

They’ve never met a war they didn’t love. But I don’t see them volunteering themselves or their loved ones to go to the front lines.

**If elected, I vow that I will NEVER send one penny of American treasure or spill one drop of American blood on ANY foreign wars—unless they are in _direct defense _of our homeland.**

_No more wars._ The American people are tired of fighting pointless, endless wars.

Putting America First and supporting our troops means only deploying our military when _absolutely necessary_.

With his unhinged rhetoric trying to start a pointless war with Russia, my opponent is putting Arkansas Last—and putting his defense industry donors first.

**[_RINO warmongers are a clear and present danger to everyone in this country. Every single one of them must be removed from office. Start by electing me._

_Send a Defense Industry shill packing and elect a real Fighter who will NEVER support another pointless foreign war_](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=966a759ece&e=eda539b26b). **

[**_Help me tell the Establishment that the people are tired of endless wars_ _ \-- Chip into my election campaign right away and show them the power of the America First movement_**](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=33c95cdfc7&e=eda539b26b) _._

_We need PATRIOTS who will**FIGHT** for the **AMERICAN** people, not the D.C Fat Cats._

[_**Your contributions to my campaign will help me purchase TV and radio ads, yard signs, and other campaign materials so I can fight the worthless GOP, retire a weak RINO, and replace him with a fierce America First Warrior**_.](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=f8a2428ba8&e=eda539b26b)

Thank you in advance for your generous support. For America,
Neil Robinson Kumar
_Republican for U.S. Congress, AR-03_

**P.S. The Republican Party of Arkansas is pulling out all the stops to kill my authentic America First campaign. ** [_**I know you're ready to replace these worthless RINOs with America First conservatives like me, and that's why I'm counting on your contribution of $5, $10, $25, $50, $100, $250, $500 or more today**_](https://NeilforArkansas.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5b07b27c744909d0ecfce3d46&id=73407e824c&e=eda539b26b)** _._**
