| | | A little truth can reveal a lot.

Our campaign amplified a brilliant news story last week that exposed Kristi Noem's bad habit of gaslighting her constituents:
[**“Gov. Noem’s New Campaign Ad is Gaslighting at its Finest”**](https://SteveHaugaard.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5c4ed239d47c47ffd9ead77d3&id=34a2ddb4b7&e=c654cab7e1)
That little bit of truth is continuing to reveal a lot about Kristi's character. Now, Noem is coming at me directly and blaming me for her own failure to protect our female athletes!

_**The truth is, as everyone knows, that she is the one who vetoed a better bill than this last year. She’s the one who left our daughters unprotected for the past year. **_

Last April, Tucker Carlson effectively ended Kristi Noem’s presidential aspirations when he called attention to the fact that she was not being truthful about the fact that she vetoed a bill that would have protected girls’ sports in South Dakota.
---
| [CLICK HERE to PROTECT GIRLS' SPORTS!](https://SteveHaugaard.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5c4ed239d47c47ffd9ead77d3&id=0aaa4849af&e=c654cab7e1 "CLICK HERE to PROTECT GIRLS' SPORTS!")
---
| She knows she made a huge mistake with that veto, when she caved to her corporate donors, siding with them against the people who voted for her. She’s desperate to fix that mistake

In accusing me of having an ‘anti-women agenda,’ and blocking this bill, she is projecting, deflecting, and ultimately, lying. Moreover, she’s using the same tired rhetoric that Hillary Clinton used to smear Donald Trump.

We in the legislature are trying to make sure a good bill gets passed, just like it got passed last year.

Hopefully, this time, she’ll actually sign it.

\- Steve Haugaard

name: Harmeet Dhillon
subject: We're suing Twitter and we need your help
body:
I’m not going to beat around the bush... we are living in a dystopian, tyrannical state. My team at the Center for America
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqci6lgnj4sfm8oqggg03kn4nmc2to120lk3d6ko_rp22sh2s8i66ob6cdim9oj4cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf6ptgcdr31otnc5hnecdhmsqb8t1kmer71o3i69qr0o5k64qbaodlmjgnas3jmurt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coqm5cr3c1p32pjksipm6ptgmlin49fg)
[](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-AAN&utm_content=AAN) Dear Fellow Conservative, I’m not going to beat around the bush... we are living in a dystopian, tyrannical state. My team at the Center for American Liberty has recently uncovered evidence of powerful elected politicians colluding with Big Tech corporations like Facebook and Twitter to de-platform and silence conservatives like you and me. **In other words, we’ve caught big government using tax-payer funding to silence their political opponents.** And if someone does not immediately stand up against this, the freedoms enshrined in our Constitution will become nothing more than meaningless words on a piece of paper. That’s why we launched a lawsuit against Twitter, U.S. Senator Alex Padilla, and a handful of liberal elected officials for their state-sponsored plot to eliminate our First Amendment liberties – _and we need your help to win._ **[Will you join us in our lawsuit against Twitter and Sen. Padilla and help defend the First Amendment?](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-AAN&utm_content=AAN)** Let me explain... Like millions of Americans after the 2020 presidential election, conservative activist Rogan O’Handley took to Twitter to express his concerns about the dubious election procedures and skepticism of the results. [](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-AAN&utm_content=AAN) [](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-AAN&utm_content=AAN) [](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-AAN&utm_content=AAN) Shortly after the election, many of Rogan's tweets were removed by Twitter and his account was permanently suspended for “violating the government’s rules about election integrity.” _Hopefully, I don’t need to explain to you that censoring or de-platforming ANY American for their political beliefs or opinions is a gross violation of the First Amendment._ But it gets much worse... When Rogan tried to figure out why he was censored, he found that bureaucrats working for then-California Secretary of State, Alex Padilla, had explicitly instructed officials at Twitter to silence him. You see, Alex Padilla was being considered to fill Kamala Harris’ vacated seat in the U.S. Senate – and he was afraid that Rogan’s tweets would hurt his image and chances of being appointed. **So, the office of Alex Padilla immediately instructed his press secretary to contact Twitter and shut Rogan up.** **From:** California Secretary of State Communications Department **To:** Twitter **Date:** Tuesday, November 17th, 2020 at 12:31 PM Hi, We wanted to flag this Twitter post: [](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-AAN&utm_content=AAN) From user @DC_Draino. In this post user claims California of being a culprit of voter fraud, and ignores the fact that we do audit votes. This is a blatant disregard to how our voting process works and creates disinformation and distrust among the general public. Twitter then flagged the post as misinformation, deleted it, and -- a few weeks later -- permanently banned Rogan from the their site. [](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-AAN&utm_content=AAN) That’s why my team and I at the Center for America Liberty are suing Twitter, now-Senator Alex Padilla, California Secretary of State Shirly Weber, and a handful of other liberals for their involvement in this blatant assault on the First Amendment. But the only way we can take on the deep pockets and deep connections of these tyrants is with the help of patriotic Americans like you. [**Will you help us fund this critical lawsuit by sending a generous, tax-deductible contribution of just $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today?**](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-AAN&utm_content=AAN) My name is Harmeet Dhillon. Two years ago, I founded the Center for American Liberty with the purpose of protecting our First Amendment freedoms and civil liberties from being destroyed by today’s left. We’ve taken on Governor Gavin Newsom in California when he unconstitutionally shut down small businesses, banned people from going to church, and kept millions of children locked up in their homes—out of school—during the pandemic. We’ve taken on Antifa for viciously assaulting and nearly killing journalist Ando Ngo who exposed Antifa’s vile, anarchic plot to destroy the United States and turn it into a socialist utopia. **And now, we’re taking on Twitter, Sen. Alex Padilla, and others for colluding to eliminate Rogan O’Handley’s freedom of speech.** But as a non-profit organization, everything we do to defend our civil liberties is with the generous help of like-minded conservative patriots like you. And this massive lawsuit is expected to cost us over $1,000,000. _After all, we are taking a multi-billion-dollar company, the state of California, and a handful of well-connected politicians._ [**So, can I count on you to help us stand up to Twitter and Senator Alex Padilla by making a tax-deductible contribution of $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today?**](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-AAN&utm_content=AAN) I’m not exaggerating when I say that this is the legal battle that will define our generation – and the future of our country. Will we sit back and allow elitist politicians, billion-dollar corporations, and faceless government agencies to continue to trample our constitutional freedoms? Or will we prove that WE, the American people, are still in control of our own lives? [**Please join us in this critical fight to defend the First Amendment by contributing $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty today.**](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-AAN&utm_content=AAN) Sincerely, Harmeet K. Dhillon P.S. For four years, leftist politicians and mainstream media figures would not let go of the bogus and unproven accusation that President Trump colluded with Russia to “steal” the 2016 election. But now that there is clear evidence that a California elected official colluded with big tech to censor conservatives who wanted to comment on the 2020 election those same leftists are dead-silent. I am absolutely fed up with left’s hypocrisy, double-standards, and blatantly unconstitutional behavior. [**That’s why I’m urgently asking you to contribute $25, $35, $50 or more to the Center for American Liberty to help us fund our lawsuit against Twitter and Senator Alex Padilla. **](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-AAN&utm_content=AAN) [**DONATE**](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-AAN&utm_content=AAN) [](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-AAN&utm_content=AAN) [Please consider supporting our efforts to defend our Constitution with a donation today.](https://secure.anedot.com/center-for-american-liberty/c8506d0b083c8a4e33dfd?utm_source=BDG-REV&utm_medium=em&utm_campaign=20220131_BDG_CFAL_TLAW_REV_PA-AAN&utm_content=AAN) The Center For American Liberty is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization created to fight against growing anti-free-speech and anti-civil liberties trends.

clean_body: | | | Senator Ted Cruz is trying to make it easier for politicians to accept bribes — the right-wing Supreme Court seems ready to back him. Sen. Cruz’s challenge to this campaign finance law would further erode the transparency of our elections and allow candidates to personally profit from running for office. We need to elect an unbought Congress who will fight to end the corruption and self-enrichment of unscrupulous politicians— and who will fight to unrig the Supreme Court. **** In Citizens United , SCOTUS opened the floodgates for dark money groups to spend unlimited special interest money to influence our elections. Now, Ted Cruz wants to take it a step further and allow even more opportunities for corrupt influence. There’s no current limit on how much money a candidate can personally “lend” their own campaign, but it does limit how much the campaign can repay them post-election to, at most, $250,000. Legal analyst and former federal prosecutor, Shan Wu succinctly lays out the problem via NBC News : Eliminating limits on how much politicians can repay themselves through campaign contributions removes the distinction between campaign contributions and paying off candidates. Republicans like Ted Cruz want to make legalized bribery even easier. These attacks on our Democracy cannot go unchallenged. Hey folks,

I can't believe we've almost made it to February – it feels like just yesterday I launched my campaign to be your next Congresswoman in MD-04. But time really does fly, and that's **why I'm asking you to become a founding donor ahead of this end-of-month fundraising deadline.**

Because if January flew by in such a hurry, I know the upcoming months are going to be even more of a whirlwind. But I'm determined and tenacious as ever to roll up my sleeves and do whatever it takes to make the lives of all Marylanders better, **I just need your help to get there.**

Become a founding donor of my campaign today and help us reach our end-of-month goal – because together, we'll create a government that will work for all of us. Here’s the link >>> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2201_email_angel?refcode=YourPersonalLink](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41283783/328123105/347518524?refcode=em22_220131_EOM3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDQ5NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjIwMjhmNi1kNDgyLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H-HtL28zvdL5TUPf7X3j0DV6Z5yW3XMH6Yaqy2yPMPY=)

I launched my campaign to represent Maryland over one month ago, on the premise that we need our government to have diverse representation and to listen to the needs of _all_ constituents – because it's always been the support of this community that has helped guide me.

When I was drafting legislation to protect campaign workers from sexual harassment, it was their courage to speak out that motivated me to fight even harder. And when I made the decision to run for Congress, it was my mother's voice in the background reminding me to lead with fearless compassion to be a true public servant.

**That's why I'm asking you – my community – to step up once again. This is a grassroots campaign and a grassroots movement, it's going to take all of us coming together to bring about the big changes we want to see. Here’s that link again – Become a founding donor today. >>> **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2201_email_angel?refcode=YourPersonalLink](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41283789/328123106/347518524?refcode=em22_220131_EOM3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDQ5NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwYjIwMjhmNi1kNDgyLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=H-HtL28zvdL5TUPf7X3j0DV6Z5yW3XMH6Yaqy2yPMPY=)

Thank you all, I've been so touched by the incredible outpouring of support. It really means a lot.

All my best,

I will use it to continue to meet with voters. Over the last week I have visited countless North Country small businesses, met people in coffee shops, bars, and even dug out a neighbor whose car was stuck in the snow. | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41284959/328127773/-870670775?refcode=fl_email_fr_20220131eom3_bf_full_xx_img&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTU5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNjUwMGM3MC1kOTgyLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=JbU2dFvxcaxNg6K2gUdd42AtRaTj2LZuUVPGr7Gj9lw=)

* We need better access to healthcare, so people don’t have to drive an hour to get a covid test

Here’s something a lot of candidates might not tell you: Every election cycle is really a series of smaller, overlapping cycles. Fundraising fluctuates from month to month (sometimes wildly!), energy surges and subsides, primary opponents announce or drop out, and — in the case of Bill Lee — elected politicians make boneheaded decisions that make people even more frustrated, and the cycle begins again.
**But what makes the movement behind our campaign so special is its _consistency_.** Because of your support, we’ve never really had a “down” month like most campaigns do.

The Chinese Communist Party (CCP) has developed a dangerous network of influence in government, education, agriculture, infrastructure, and business. They have targeted leaders at all levels of government, including Idaho leaders, to advance CCP interests and policies under the guise of building cultural ties and economic alliances. The CCP uses academic and economic arrangements to penetrate US innovators, such as Micron, and steal their ideas and technology. University programs, such as the Confucius Institute and Chinese Students and Scholars Association (CSSA) which are found in Idaho universities are used to sanitize the public image of CCP's murderous policies and soften students to anti-American indoctrination. On January 19, 2021, Donald Trump issued what may prove to be the most important Executive Order of his presidency. He declared a national emergency arising from the investments unwary Americans are being induced to make in the Chinese Communist Party's military-industrial complex.

body:
I am sending a personal note asking if you will donate to our January fundraising deadline before tonight at midnight.
#

Good morning -
I am sending a personal note asking if you will donate to our January fundraising deadline before tonight at midnight:
[**https://go.giffords.org/go/January**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/giffords-em-jan22-eom?refcode=em220131-1-30&t=1&refcode2=1515_3935704_CFzwSr&akid=1515%2E3935704%2ECFzwSr)
We’re a few donations away from where we need to be, and it’s so important we meet this goal.
Because of supporters like you, we’re able to get the hard work done to stand up to the gun lobby and save lives. That’s why I need to reach out and ask you to donate.
This is an election year, and there is a lot on the line. We need to ensure that gun safety is a top priority in campaigns and elections across the country, and we need to keep our gun safety majority in Congress.
[**So please, make a $3 contribution towards our $115,000 fundraising goal before tonight at midnight.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/giffords-em-jan22-eom?refcode=em220131-1-30&t=2&refcode2=1515_3935704_CFzwSr&akid=1515%2E3935704%2ECFzwSr)
This year, the gun lobby is set on blocking and unraveling all of our honest work. They want to see us fail. We are not going to let that happen.
Together, we are going to save lives and make this country a better, safer place for all Americans.
Thank you for doing your part.
All my best,
Gabby

When I decided to run for the U.S. Senate, I knew that it was a HUGE undertaking and I would never be able to do it without a lot of help.

So far the best part of campaigning has been meeting people across all parts of the state. And I am hearing from folks that they’re sick and tired of politicians putting their own self-interests over the actual wants and the dire needs of Oklahomans.

| |
---
Please see and share the call to action below, and thank you for all you do! We also want to share a great resource with you from our friends at Honest Elections Project Action. They compiled examples of Democrats casting doubts on election results – when _they_ lose. [**Check it out and share it widely!**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-p9XiYUbTusvGD8I8R3MPQ)

**In this week’s call-to-action**
* AZ & NV residents: Sign up for Election Integrity meetings!
* Oppose David Weil’s nomination in the Senate

|
---
Manhattan's new District Attorney, Alvin Bragg, [wants to stop prosecuting criminals](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-X0oi6Mhj_rQ). He sent guidance to his office decriminalizing a range of offenses, including trespassing, turnstile jumping and resisting arrest. He also promised never to seek life without parole regardless of the crime and will only recommend pretrial detention in a tiny number of cases.

The New York Police Benevolent Association immediately pushed back on Bragg's policies because they would leave potentially dangerous criminals on the streets.

Pretending crime isn't happening won't make it go away. Bragg's policies will only exacerbate the situation in New York City as shootings are already [double ](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.-gZK8g)what they were two years ago. Other cities that have tried similar policies have reaped the [predictably disastrous consequences](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) of ignoring crime.
|
---
If you live in Arizona or Nevada (or know people who do), please make plans to attend of the Election Integrity meetings happening in your state in February!

Tea Party Patriots Action is working to build permanent Election Integrity infrastructure in every state, beginning with the states that play an outsized role in national elections and saw many irregularities in 2020.

Election Integrity will not happen without you, though, so please RSVP, share the sign up info with friends, and attend one of these meetings!
[ARIZONA RSVP](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
[NEVADA RSVP](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
|
---
Liberal school districts [played the Biden administration like a fiddle](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) last spring. The administration allocated schools $130 billion through its American Rescue Plan to help with school reopening, only to see administrators use large chunks of this funding on Critical Race Theory.

Chicago spent $32 million of this money on a "comprehensive, culturally responsive curriculum," and the Chicago Teachers Union has now [closed down](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._Z-ZD_NNp4Q) the schools because they don't want to teach in person. Similarly, Milwaukee used $24 million on "Social Emotional Learning" efforts and is now not opening until at least January 10.

Parents are sick of woke school officials spending taxpayer dollars on political indoctrination efforts while [4,500 schools](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._aWQ9ODIwNzQ4MTUmbWlkPTQ0ODg3JmlkPVQxOG85TG5ldWpIaGs5MVFRUSJ9/dzZKKZ54_hPDEpHUw_W9Yw) have shut back down, using coronavirus as the excuse.
|
---
Joe Biden has nominated David Weil to run the Wage and Hour Division of the Labor Department, and he is yet another radical nominee that we must defeat.

Who is David Weil? He held this same position in the Obama administration and did all he could (including breaking the law!) to destroy small businesses, franchises, contract employees, and gig economy workers (like Uber and Lyft drivers).

He also wants everyone to be unionized – whether they want to or not.

[**Read this Wall Street Journal article first,**](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.) then call your Senators and tell them both to vote NO on David Weil’s confirmation.
[FIND SENATOR’S NUMBERS](http://lnk.teapartypatriots.)
|
---
President Biden [continues to push his vaccine mandate](http://lnk.teapartypatriots._APJuTt-fA) even as the county reaps the consequences of his invasive and overly broad policy. About 10,000 Marines haven't complied with the mandate and believe it is a political purge. The mandate has also caused a massive nursing shortage as many Americans are choosing their liberty over their jobs.

The Supreme Court will likely rule on Biden's mandate in the coming days, and we hope they choose liberty over control. The president's choices have hamstrung crucial industries while forcing workers to choose between their job and their conscience and health.
|
---

| | | Last week, Supreme Court Justice Stephen Breyer announced his decision to retire, allowing President Biden time to nominate a successor, and for confirmation by a Democratic-led Senate. [**We want to thank Justice Breyer for all he has done to serve America during the past several decades, and for doing the right thing now.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tfc34a1c3-719c-4f98-bc28-6a14371cc651/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) After Republicans blocked Merrick Garland, and stole their way to a right-wing Supreme Court, we need to make sure we have Justices who will protect and defend voting rights, reproductive rights, and more. Thanks to Justice Breyer’s decision, Democrats now have the opportunity to appoint the first Black woman Supreme Court Justice. Help us thank Justice Breyer and celebrate his decision by adding your name now: [Sign your name: Thank Supreme Court Justice Stephen Breyer for his decision to retire >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4f876e71-e0e7-4828-beac-0c6d96420e0b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

A few key facts about myself that you may find informative:
* I’m a first generation American, the son of two Haitian immigrants. **My parents immigrated to the United States to pick crops** in order to provide for our family.
* At 17, I enlisted in the Navy and served six years planning and executing the deployment of Tomahawk Land Attack Missiles.
* I attended Syracuse University Law School on the G.I. Bill.
* Following graduation, **I worked for the Department of Commerce under President Trump** (the honor of a lifetime!).

For Country,

Rod Dorilás

| _**ABOUT ROD**_

Rod Dorilás is the first-generation son of two immigrants from Haiti. His father immigrated to Florida to pick crops, and eventually his parents went on to own a small business. From a young age, his parents instilled in him the importance of hard work, integrity, and service.

At age 17, Rod enlisted in the United States Navy, serving for six years as a Petty Officer Second Class and Assistant Engagement Control Officer onboard the USS The Sullivans, stationed in Jacksonville. There, he was responsible for planning and executing the deployment of Tomahawk Land Attack Missiles on the Ballistic Missile Defense destroyer.

Upon completion of his military service, Rod attended law school at Syracuse University with the help of the G.I. Bill. After graduating, he served in President Trump's Administration in the U.S. Department of Commerce. While serving our great nation, Rod fought tirelessly to ensure that American families and businesses weren't taken advantage of by China.

Rod is a true public servant and is dedicated to serving his country and community. He wants to ensure that every American, through hard work and perseverance, can achieve the American Dream. Rod is running for Congress in South Florida to continue Trump's America First Agenda and defend our country from the Radical Left.

body:
Where were you when the lights went out in Texas?

For millions across this state, not only did last February's power grid
failure plunge their homes into darkness, but their heaters stopped
working, their pipes froze, and, unable to charge their phones or use
their computers, they lost the ability to reach the outside world.

It wasn’t an act of God, nor the incredible force of Mother Nature. It
wasn’t a failure of turbines or technicians.

This was wholly the fault of the governor, the man who had been repeatedly
warned of vulnerabilities in the grid and who did nothing. The man who,
instead of being with Texans in their moment of need, was on Fox News
blaming the Green New Deal.

Greg Abbott failed Texas. [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/52106?refcode=ema20220131-174116&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=174116%2E444211%2EXR3Wzu ]If you agree, I hope you'll consider making a
donation to defeat him, and help power our campaign for all Texans forward
before our January fundraising deadline at midnight tonight.

Abbott failed to prepare us for a completely preventable disaster, and
then, after millions lost power and hundreds died because they froze to
death in the energy capital of the world, he failed to make changes that
would protect us from the next extreme weather event. That might be
because his largest political donors profited from the suffering of
Texans. Kelcy Warren’s company, for example, made over $2.4 billion on the
grid failure. He wrote Abbott a $1 million check soon after.

And to add insult to injury, Abbott forced the ratepayers to clean up his
mess. Every Texas home will have to pay the Abbott Tax – an increase of at
least $20-50 per month on our utility bills for the coming decades.

For the next two weeks, I will drive to the communities in Texas that bore
the brunt of Abbott’s failure. I’ll meet with those who found a way to
come through, and hear from those who lost loved ones that didn’t. I’ll
learn from everyday Texans who stepped up to lead in their communities
when their own governor refused to. And I’ll lay out the steps I will take
to make sure this never happens again.

This is a drive to keep the lights on in Texas. To make sure we have a
government that works for, and is accountable to, everyone in this state.
[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/52106?refcode=ema20220131-174116&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=174116%2E444211%2EXR3Wzu ]Your support today will ensure that we can talk to as many Texans as
possible over these next two weeks and offer our vision for a brighter
Texas.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/52106?refcode=ema20220131-174116&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=174116%2E444211%2EXR3Wzu ]Contribute $3

Thanks for helping to make it possible,

Beto

P.S. To join us on the drive, [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/52132?t=1022&akid=174116%2E444211%2EXR3Wzu ]click here.

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/bft-unsubscribe/?t=1023&akid=174116%2E444211%2EXR3Wzu

Dan returns to Washington, DC tomorrow to fight the latest attempts by Biden and Pelosi to ram their socialist agenda through Congress. While he's in DC fighting for our conservative values, it's up to us to keep building the grassroots momentum at home. Our first critical fundraising deadline of 2022 is just a few hours away. Peter, our campaign is powered by supporters like YOU. == | | | == | Since day one of the Biden Administration, Dan has led the fight to defend your priorities in Congress. Dan introduced legislation that would prohibit the federal government from requiring proof of vaccination or the use of a vaccine passport for things like air travel. And he fought back against Department of Defense leaders who punished service members for choosing not to take the vaccine. Friend -- As parents, Carolyn and I understand the importance of turning around the state of our education system in Illinois. That’s why we created the Parents’ Bill of Rights. Illinois’ students have fallen behind because of extended school closings and political agendas. The Parents’ Bill of Rights advocates for schools to be free of political indoctrination and allows for parents to have control over how their child is raised. Carolyn and I don’t believe that government oversight should be in our children’s schools. The state should be empowering parents with real choices, but instead they’re taking their voice away. Springfield has lost sight of the fact that parents, not the government, have the authority and responsibility to raise their children. We trust you to make your own family decisions. As Governor and Lieutenant Governor, we will restore the rights of parents and families and set Springfield straight. But we need your help to get there. Donate to our campaign [here](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/donate?e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=parents_bor_donor&n=2) to help us get our message out to parents all across the state, so we can continue our fight to renew Illinois. | [](https://www.schimpf4illinois.com/donate?e=1469e37fec1f8638fc00965d010776f6&utm_source=schimpf4illinois&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=parents_bor_donor&n=3 "DONATE HERE!") | | Peter, the race for the open seat here in Wisconsin’s 3rd Congressional District could determine control of Congress. I know that if we work together, we can keep this seat and ensure equal rights and opportunities.

**Our campaign is about respecting every person, and helping them gain opportunity to thrive.** I believe ‘life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness’ are both responsibilities and imperatives to our way of life. Although our state and nation have made progress towards equality and support for the LGBTQ+ members of our communities, we still have so much work to do.

This is personal to me and many families. One of my children is gay. He came out to me when he was a scared teenager and we were living in Hungary - a country that is now openly hostile to people like him. I never want America to be a country where someone is afraid to be themselves. Friend, my campaign is about to close the books on January with a $4,356 shortfall.

We need to be _bolstering_ our efforts to keep this seat blue and _expand_ Democratic control of the Senate. With everything from reproductive rights to voting rights to climate justice and more on the line, falling short is not an option.
Your donation right now could prevent us from facing a shortfall.

subject: reaching out myself to explain why your support is so important
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
I made a promise that this campaign would be different.

Hi there - I wanted to reach out myself before tonight’s fundraising deadline to explain why your donation is so important.
When we launched this campaign, I said we had to try something new in North Carolina because the old playbook wasn’t cutting it. I made a promise that this campaign would be different.
On Election Day 2020, North Carolina’s Senate race was the most expensive Senate race in U.S. history. Over $280 million was spent from Republicans, Democrats, and every super PAC pouring record sums into our state.
Republicans are going to try their same playbook — let far-right super PACs spend extreme sums of dark money on attack ads. There’s no limit to what they’re willing to spend to buy this seat.
Now the truth is we’re going to have to respond to all these attacks, but that won’t be enough. As I said, the path to victory hinges on a new strategy.
So we’re also going to build the largest grassroots campaign our state has ever seen. This will be a campaign that reaches out to people from the Appalachian Mountains to the Outer Banks. Anyone who has felt silenced or left behind by Washington will have a voice in us — because you and your family deserve a Senator who will speak up and fight for YOU in Washington.
But this will be expensive. So we need to raise the resources now to lay the groundwork to fight back and win.
[**That’s why a donation from you is so important today. So I’m asking you myself, please consider pitching in $3 or any amount you can afford today to help us flip North Carolina.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-em-jan22/?refcode=em220131-1-ma&refcode2=337.357359.KeVcbP&t=1&akid=337%2E357359%2EKeVcbP)
Now that Democrats are united and focused on the general election, this campaign is Republicans' sole target in this race. We must be ready for anything.
Thank you for your support,
Cheri

name: American Update
subject: The key to Lincoln’s rhetorical success
body:
Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c8403%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=EUzgJ7%2fI0a79Tx6PZOobmA&sysid=1)
This sponsored message from American Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c13521%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0OrcV8vXIsL9swfzbDB3gA&sysid=1)
---
| | Dear fellow American, Asked by a reporter in 1860 how he had acquired his extraordinary rhetorical skills, Abraham Lincoln credited his study of Euclid. While studying law in Springfield, Lincoln explained, he became convinced that the ability to demonstrate the truth of things was essential to the good practice of law. Consequently, Lincoln left his job, retired to his father’s cabin, and did not return until he could “give any proposition in the six books of Euclid at sight.” By studying Euclid, we improve our ability to reason soundly--plus, in my experience, the study of Euclid can be great fun. That’s why Hillsdale College has produced a free online course on the topic **“Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry.” ** Through** “Mathematics and Logic: From Euclid to Modern Geometry,”** you will learn the importance of deductive reasoning as a foundation for pursuing knowledge in all fields of learning, as well as in everyday life.

name: John Fetterman
subject: This email is long but important
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
Let me explain why supporting our campaign today is so incredibly important right now.
#
Derek,
With just a few hours left before our January fundraising deadline, **[let me explain why supporting our campaign with a $5 donation is the *most* important thing you can do to help our campaign right now.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/42372?refcode=ema20220131-4409&t=1&akid=4409%2E434096%2EV_CRnO)**
I’ll just start out with something I think about every day 👇
All eyes will be on the Keystone State this November. **This Senate seat is gonna be a real toss-up, so saving our razor-thin Democratic Senate majority could all come down to Pennsylvania.**
Don’t just take my word for it. **CNN has consistently rated Pennsylvania as the #1 Most Likely to Flip Democratic state in the country.** We all remember what happened when Pennsylvania flipped _the other way_ in 2016. That’s why building support for the long road ahead is so critical right now.
Then there’s the latest polling, Derek. According to the data we’ve seen so far, voters overwhelmingly see our campaign as the *only* campaign that can flip this seat + beat a Republican in the general election. That’s the kind of momentum we’ve gotta keep up during this early period.
**Derek, here is my solemn pledge to you:**
Send me to the U.S. Senate, and I will *always* act with conviction and vote in favor of progress for the working families of our Commonwealth.
Send me to the U.S. Senate, and I will be the 51st Democratic YES vote on urgent changes, like passing vital voting rights legislation + abolishing the filibuster.
**Send me to the U.S. Senate, and I will be a leader for ALL Pennsylvanians.** No one taken for granted. No one left behind.
But I *truly* cannot get there without a lot of help from online supporters like you, Derek.
That’s why I’m humbly + respectfully asking one last time before our critical fundraising deadline at midnight: 🙏
**[Will you please make your very first $5 donation to our campaign today? We’re SO CLOSE to meeting our goal — and we only have until midnight to get it done.](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/42372?refcode=ema20220131-4409&t=2&akid=4409%2E434096%2EV_CRnO)**
**[Contribute $5](https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/42372?refcode=em20220131-4409&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=4409%2E434096%2EV_CRnO)**
On behalf of me, Gisele, the kids, and our entire campaign, THANK YOU for your continued support! We can only do this together. 💛
Let's get it done,
John
John Fetterman
Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220131-4409-footer&t=22&refcode2=4409_434096_V_CRnO&akid=4409%2E434096%2EV_CRnO)**

body:
“Much needed” is a phrase our campaign team uses a lot to describe the work we’re doing to elect Morgan Harper.
# [](https://act.morganharper.org/go/1512?refcode=em20220131-596-footer-ak&t=2&akid=596%2E90090%2EDTxPAy)
Hi I’m Cade, Team Morgan Harper’s Campaign Manager. It’s great to meet you if you haven’t received an email from me yet. 👋
[**_If you’re in a rush feel free to donate to our end-of-month fundraising goal before midnight tonight._**](https://act.morganharper.org/go/24245?t=3&akid=596%2E90090%2EDTxPAy) _Right now we’re still $4,823 short of our fundraising goal but if everyone chips in we can make up that ground in no time!_
“Much needed” is a phrase you’ll hear a lot around the Morgan Harper headquarters. Our team members consistently say it when we’re eating a plate of comfort food after organizing in a blizzard, when you bite into a spoonful of Jeni’s Brambleberry crisp ice cream, have a refreshing conversation with a new member of Team Morganize on our neighborhood canvasses, **and more.**
It represents a breath of fresh air and a sigh of relief.
**Morgan is the much needed fresh air and break from the tired demographic of politicians in Ohio that we’ve been accustomed to.** She’s original, contemporary, and driven by public service. And more than anything, she’s devoted to uplifting hard working Ohioans.
Now here’s what makes our movement so special: _You’re much needed too!!_
We don’t take a penny of fossil fuel, super PAC, or corporate money and we couldn’t be prouder. But that means we depend on a steady stream of grassroots fundraising to power our campaign — **and** **every donation we receive has a direct impact on what we can do so we need everyone to step up. For example, if 483 people each donate just $10 then we’re guaranteed to hit our goal!**
I’ll be honest, our fundraising has slowed ***dramatically*** since we launched — but our organizing and campaigning hasn’t. **[_Can you donate $5 before tonight so we can keep fighting for Ohio? Your contribution today will make all the difference in our campaign’s success, and we only have a few hours left to make up ground._](https://act.morganharper.org/go/24245?t=4&akid=596%2E90090%2EDTxPAy) **
**[Contribute $5](https://act.morganharper.org/go/24251?refcode=em20220131-596&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=23&akid=596%2E90090%2EDTxPAy)**
Thank you for everything you do,
Cade
Campaign Manager
Morgan Harper for U.S. Senate
**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mh-email?refcode=em20220131-596-footer&t=24&refcode2=596_90090_DTxPAy&akid=596%2E90090%2EDTxPAy)**

Last week, someone told me something that I've been thinking a lot about. She said every time she thinks about sitting this election out, she thinks about what she’s willing to lose if Republicans take control of the House.

**And her answer: nothing.**

And you know what? Neither am I.

Because this cycle is about so much more than defeating Mike Garcia. It's about protecting reproductive rights and the right to decide what to do with your own body. It's about getting rid of the outsized influence of corporate lobbyists and billionaires over everyday people. It's about passing universal Pre-K and making higher education affordable so we are investing in the future of our children.

**I'm not willing to risk anything but we know exactly what will happen if Republicans take control of the House in November. And the path toward maintaining our House majority runs right through this district.**

body:
Folks,

With the Supreme Court on the verge of overturning Roe v. Wade, the fight
for reproductive freedom has never been more important.

But here in Rhode Island, the right to choose is not yet truly universal,
especially when cost is a barrier to accessing abortion care. That’s
becuase state law does not allow Medicaid or state health plans to cover
abortions.

And just last week, the Rhode Island Supreme Court heard a case that would
strike down the Reproductive Privacy Act, the state law that protects the
right to abortion care to all Rhode Islanders.

Let us be clear: abortion rights are under attack across the country,
Rhode Island included.

That’s outrageous — and it’s a direct
consequence of the current conservative establishment actively obstructing
the right to choose. It won’t happen on our watch; our administration
would do everything possible to protect reproductive rights.

body:

---
Friend -- Jake, new Finance Director at the Republican Party of Wisconsin here. As one of our top supporters, I wanted to reach out to make sure you knew about our End of Month Deadline. I was brought on board as Finance Director to make sure we have the resources to win in November. **Unlike the Democrats, we don’t have coastal liberals from California and New York bankrolling our efforts. We rely on the support of our grassroots army to keep our movement strong through Election Day.** [**Will you help us make sure we have a strong showing for our first End of Month Deadline of the year?**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDV0XVu91EQGAXpQxCBIFpiR96FqMUavGDVz7aU601js7o&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=january_deadline_v1&n=2) We know that you already do so much for our Party, and we don’t take the continued asks for money lightly – but the fact is that while we have so much we need to accomplish this year, victory is only possible with grassroots financial support. **Democrats like Nancy Pelosi and Chuck Schumer are already lining up liberal elites to parachute in and flood our state with false attacks against Senator Johnson – and we need to make sure we have the resources to fight back.** Some of the efforts our donations support include:
* Opening campaign headquarters in communities across the state
* Purchasing digital ads to get the conservative message directly to voters
* Growing our staff in all departments to make sure we have a well-rounded team and the manpower to compete
* Funding our legal strategy for election integrity efforts
* ...and much more.

This is our first deadline of the year, and we need to show that we’re ready for the fight. [**I hope we can count on your help.**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=K115QJUsYIJk1EqYiO2oYo--3UqFRYFg8Lsn0cgAtTvheTZIBulG9nsDqgd8dcDV0XVu91EQGAXpQxCBIFpiR96FqMUavGDVz7aU601js7o&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=january_deadline_v1&n=3) Thanks, Jake Ottinger

I’m proud to support my friend Peter Welch in his campaign for U.S. Senate. Will you join me?
# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=93%2E61531%2ERRUDUt)
Hi There — it's Adam Schiff. I wanted to take a moment to explain why I’m supporting Peter Welch’s campaign for U.S. Senate in Vermont, and why it’s critical we work together to ensure he’s elected.
Peter and I have served together on the House Intelligence Committee for years. I’ve seen firsthand his thoughtfulness and integrity, and his steadfast determination to protect our democracy and the right to vote. He knows how to get things done – for working families, for Vermont, and for our country.
I’m honored to put my full support behind his Senate campaign – because with the Senate hanging in the balance, we cannot afford to lose one seat. I hope you’ll join me in supporting his campaign today.
[**Pitch in $5 — or whatever you can — to help elect Peter in Vermont. His campaign has their first end-of-month deadline coming up tonight, and they need to close the gap. Anything you can give will go directly to keeping Vermont blue and defending our Democratic Senate majority.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/1323?t=3&akid=93%2E61531%2ERRUDUt)

Peter will make an excellent Senator. From his time as a community organizer working to dismantle housing discrimination to his time in the House fighting to lower prescription drug prices, he always puts working people at the center of everything he does. And with our democracy in peril, we need public servants like Peter in the Senate — individuals who work to uphold their oath of office and our Constitution.
It’s going to take all of us working together to make sure he can get to the Senate. The Senate is split 50-50, which means Mitch McConnell and Republicans will do everything and anything to flip the Senate. That means coming to Vermont to try and buy this seat. We can’t let that happen.
If we’re going to hold onto our Senate majority, we need to send Peter Welch to the Senate. Will you join me in supporting his campaign?
[**Please, chip in $5 right away ahead of Peter’s crucial end-of-month deadline so we can hold on to our Senate majority and defend our democracy. Adam Schiff

# **It's Time to Debate the Issues**
I'm running for office to defeat Susan Wild, restore the Republican majority in Congress, and defend our freedoms against government overreach. But I need to win the Republican primary first.

So far, the only other declared candidate in the primary is Lisa Scheller, who lost against Susan Wild in 2020. Lisa and I have different ideas about how to defeat Susan Wild and restore hometown values to Washington. And we have different views on many important issues, including standing up to China, outsourcing jobs overseas, and defending unborn children.

That's why it's critically important for Republican voters to hear from both candidates, early and often.

Last week, I invited Lisa Scheller to a series of six debates across Pennsylvania's 7th District. If other candidates enter the race, they are welcome to join us. I hope and expect she will accept this offer, which is explained on my website **[here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=80078887a1&e=1090c5c412)**.

This campaign is about issues. If you want to know where I stand, please visit the **[ISSUES](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=f05f906415&e=1090c5c412)** page on my website, read my campaign **[BLOG](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=e34cdbdeab&e=1090c5c412)** , or send me an **[EMAIL](mailto:kevin@dellickerforcongress.com)** with your questions.

You deserve to know what your elected officials will do to improve our country, defend the Constitution, and Keep America Free!

| **Protecting Unborn Children**

I was pleased to learn last week that I earned a 100% rating from the Pennsylvania Pro-Life Federation PAC. I am genuinely Pro-Life. If you send me to Congress, I will work to protect and defend all unborn children. And I will promote policies that help expectant mothers, support fatherhood, and encourage young parents. **[Learn More](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=f3646ff243&e=1090c5c412)**.

| **Environmental Extremism Hurts American Jobs while Destabilizing Europe**

The _Wall Street Journal_ published an [**article**](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=dfed9bfea8&e=1090c5c412) last Sunday about Europe's dependence on Russia for its energy needs. Since about 40% of the continent's natural gas comes from Russia, Vladimir Putin has tremendous leverage. He literally can turn off the heat to people's homes in the dead of winter.

But it didn't have to be this way. For years, U.S. companies have offered to ship American liquefied natural gas to Europe, which would create American jobs and stabilize European energy markets. But the French turned us down because the environmentalists there didn't approve of our fracking methods. And the Swedes turned us down because they thought it might increase global warming. Now Europe is beholden to Putin, facing an energy crisis, and on the brink of war.

Don't think we are immune to that type of environmental extremism here. A few years ago, Northeastern activists made it so difficult to ship American natural gas through domestic pipelines to Massachusetts that they had to import their fuel from Russia instead. You can read about it **[here](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=d26c4446de&e=1090c5c412).**

With the world on the brink of another European war, it's important to understand how we got to this point. Make no mistake: we should not be sending American troops to fight and die in Ukraine. clean_body: It's time to debate the issues | | | | | | | It's Time to Debate the Issues I'm running for office to defeat Susan Wild, restore the Republican majority in Congress, and defend our freedoms against government overreach. But I need to win the Republican primary first. So far, the only other declared candidate in the primary is Lisa Scheller, who lost against Susan Wild in 2020. Lisa and I have different ideas about how to defeat Susan Wild and restore hometown values to Washington. And we have different views on many important issues, including standing up to China, outsourcing jobs overseas, and defending unborn children. That's why it's critically important for Republican voters to hear from both candidates, early and often. Last week, I invited Lisa Scheller to a series of six debates across Pennsylvania's 7th District. If other candidates enter the race, they are welcome to join us. I hope and expect she will accept this offer, which is explained on my website . This campaign is about issues. If you want to know where I stand, please visit the page on my website, read my campaign , or send me an mailto:kevin@dellickerforcongress.com with your questions. You deserve to know what your elected officials will do to improve our country, defend the Constitution, and Keep America Free! | "Learn More" | | Kevin is hard at work to promote Strong Families , Good Jobs , and Safe Communities. Here's what happened since our last update. | | Strong Families | | Protecting Unborn Children I was pleased to learn last week that I earned a 100% rating from the Pennsylvania Pro-Life Federation PAC. I am genuinely Pro-Life. If you send me to Congress, I will work to protect and defend all unborn children. And I will promote policies that help expectant mothers, support fatherhood, and encourage young parents. . | | Good Jobs | | Environmental Extremism Hurts American Jobs while Destabilizing Europe The Wall Street Journal published an last Sunday about Europe's dependence on Russia for its energy needs. Since about 40% of the continent's natural gas comes from Russia, Vladimir Putin has tremendous leverage. He literally can turn off the heat to people's homes in the dead of winter. But it didn't have to be this way. For years, U.S. companies have offered to ship American liquefied natural gas to Europe, which would create American jobs and stabilize European energy markets. But the French turned us down because the environmentalists there didn't approve of our fracking methods. And the Swedes turned us down because they thought it might increase global warming. Now Europe is beholden to Putin, facing an energy crisis, and on the brink of war. Don't think we are immune to that type of environmental extremism here. A few years ago, Northeastern activists made it so difficult to ship American natural gas through domestic pipelines to Massachusetts that they had to import their fuel from Russia instead. You can read about it . | | Safe Communities | | President Biden and Washington Democrats have weakened our hand in Ukraine With the world on the brink of another European war, it's important to understand how we got to this point. Last week, we kicked off a statewide tour across rural Wisconsin, where we met with farmers, small business owners, mental health workers, teachers, and others to discuss my new plan for our rural communities. I have a few pictures to share with you. Last week, we kicked off a statewide tour across rural Wisconsin, where we met with farmers, small business owners, mental health workers, teachers, and others to discuss my new plan for our rural communities. I have a few pictures to share with you below, but let me briefly start with this:

We are creating an agenda for all Wisconsinites so that we can get this U.S. Senate seat working for everyone again — because the people of our state may not be Ron Johnson’s priority, but they are mine. That’s why I got in this race, and it’s why I’ve been out on the road so much.

If we want to defeat Ron Johnson in November, we’ve got to show up, listen, earn trust, and follow through on our word — particularly in places Democrats don’t always go. We need to build a campaign that can compete everywhere and talk to everyone, which is exactly what we’re doing.

**[Can you chip in to support our efforts ahead of tonight’s monthly fundraising deadline? Your contribution will keep us on the road, traveling all over Wisconsin and getting our message out to voters. With Ron Johnson officially in the race, there’s never been a more important time to give. Click here to pitch in.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/41292070/328159870/-959429831?refcode=em22_220131_eom6_fnd_gq_act___sg_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220131_eom6_fnd_gq_act___sg_ettx&utm_medium=email&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODI4NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MTNkZDRlMy1mMTgyLWVjMTEtOTRmNi1jODk2NjUwZDQ0NDIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=kcsfO2LU0TSjr6Ms6yUNl4knIw8MGgH8RDVVXZf920s=)**

Now, here are some of my favorite moments from our rural tour:

Our first stop was Landmark Creamery. It was so great to be with the two Annas for a cheesy lunchtime adventure! These incredible small business owners are working with farmers to build sustainable, family-run dairies that support the local economy — one wedge at a time.

Next, we drove to Coloma Farms, where Andy showed us around. After the tour, Andy and Steve both took the time to discuss the importance of conservation and supporting our farmers, now more than ever. This Waushara County family farm is a great example of how our farmers are putting sustainability into practice.

Then, we stopped in Viroqua, where I met with Mayor Karen Mischel to talk about how climate change and economic security issues are impacting communities like hers. If we want all Wisconsinites to thrive, we have to make investments that matter — in conservation, housing, childcare, and more. That’s what I’m fighting for in this campaign.

We spent the night in Eau Claire and headed off to rural Augusta the next morning. Being from western Wisconsin, I’m certainly no stranger to subzero weather — but holy cow, was it a cold one! The way I see it, if farmers like Matt can wake up early, roll up their sleeves, and get to work, they should expect the same from their U.S. Senator. Even the cold couldn’t stop me from getting fired up about my plan to better support our farmers. That’s the commitment I’ll bring to the U.S. Senate.

Next stop: Merrill, where my good friend Renea was able to join us for a factory tour at the Weinbrenner Shoe Company. Renea is the co-owner of nearby FreMarq Innovations, another Merrill manufacturer we toured just last summer. Here in Wisconsin, manufacturing is an important part of our story, so I was grateful to Dennis for showing us around and talking about the struggles of being a manufacturer in a rural area. Weinbrenner makes some of the best work boots in the world, right here in Wisconsin. (You bet I bought myself a pair!)

After that, we made the drive up north to Ashland and made our way over to Superior for a mental health worker roundtable. Everywhere I go, I hear about struggles with mental health — getting treatment and prevention simply isn't an option for too many, especially in rural communities. It was great to chat with community members about how we can improve mental health services, give schools the resources they need, and support working parents. Shortly after, I also met with educators to talk about the challenges they’re facing in this ongoing pandemic, and most importantly, what I can do to help.

Finally, we ended our road trip by catching the sunset at the lighthouse on beautiful Lake Superior. As Senator, I’ll always work to preserve our Great Lakes and ensure public lands stay in public hands so that future generations can continue to enjoy Wisconsin’s natural resources.

I’m so glad we did this tour. There’s nothing like being on the road and having important conversations about the challenges so many of our communities are facing right now, especially in areas Democrats don’t typically spend a lot of time in. Those conversations have shaped our priorities in this campaign, which is the way this should work! And it’s how we’re going to win.

Having grown up in western Wisconsin, with deep family roots in our rural areas, I know that no matter where folks live in our state, they should have access to jobs, education, health care, and the overall quality of life they want and deserve.

I’m running for U.S. Senate to be the leader our state needs right now — someone who will never stop showing up, listening, and working as hard as possible to get results. That's what I have done as State Treasurer, and it’s what I intend to do as Wisconsin’s next U.S. Senator.

But flipping any seat from red to blue is a challenge (especially during a midterm election in Wisconsin, and you can take my word for it!). It’s an effort that requires a whole lot of resources. So, while we’re getting our message out across the state, I’m hoping I can count on you to help us keep it going.

[**We have a really good shot at defeating Ron Johnson, but only if enough folks like you support our efforts each step of the way. Will you help us return this Senate seat to the people of Wisconsin by chipping in before tonight’s end-of-month fundraising deadline? name: Victor Davis Hanson
subject: The decline of American Citizenship
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWQISRWHNA

I wish to invite you to enroll in an eight-lecture course that I
prepared with the help and under the auspices of Hillsdale
College. It is called.....
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWQISRWHNA

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Friend,

I wish to
invite you to enroll in an eight-lecture course that I prepared
with the help and under the auspices of Hillsdale College. It is
called "American Citizenship and Its Decline," and the online
course is based on my latest book, the recently released The
Dying Citizen.

Like the
book, the course describes the current crises in America as
symptoms of a far larger problem: the steady decline of the
autonomy and political influence of the citizen.

The class
describes the origins and history of citizenship in the West,
reminding us that it is a rare phenomenon both in the past and
the present-given the enormous responsibility placed on citizens
to create and control their own government.

Citizenship then requires a large and self-reliant middle
class-currently shrinking under enormous economic strains.
Clearly defined and enforced borders are also essential to ensure
a civic space in which citizens can nurture common customs,
sustain traditions, and honor their own shared past.

Yet
borders are now increasingly fluid as mere residence and
citizenship seem often indistinguishable. Pre-civilizational
tribalism-identifying by superficial appearance rather than
through shared culture and values-is returning to America as so
often the salad bowl replaces the melting pot.

These
organic, bottom-up challenges are often matched by top-down
stresses such as the growth of a permanent, but unelected,
government of bureaucrats and administrators who combine
judicial, executive, and legislative powers that overwhelm the
citizen.

In
addition, revisionists in law, the media, and politics seek to
change the Constitution, long-held customs of governance, and
political traditions for short-term partisan agendas, on the
theory that a new changing and fluid Constitution must match an
always evolving human nature.

Globalism
is an ancient challenge to the sovereignty of the nation-state.
But in the age of instant communications and unprecedented
concentrations of globalized wealth, so often elites seek to
supplant American laws and independence with international
organizations and often without the consent of the legislative
branch or the assent of the governed.

The
course ends, however, on an optimistic note that citizens still
have it within their power to restore our traditions of empowered
citizenship and return government to the control of citizens.

"American
Citizenship and Its Decline" is free to enroll in, and you can
begin the course today by clicking on the secure link below.

https://online.hillsdale.edu/landing/american-citizenship-and-its-decline

Best
wishes,

Victor
Davis Hanson
Wayne &
Marcia Buske Distinguished Fellow in History

Hillsdale
College

**We recently got new district lines in CA-01.** The share of Latino voters in our district almost doubled from 12% to 20%. That gives us an opportunity to win votes with our positive message of economic opportunity and bringing new, family-sustaining jobs to our district. LaMalfa’s record on these issues falls completely flat.

**These new lines will make LaMalfa very uncomfortable.** He'll have to talk to new voters who haven't heard from him, and I bet he'll have a real tough time explaining why he's covering for Trump and making excuses for the Jan. 6th insurrectionists.

[](https://mobrooksforsen.nationbuilder.com/r?u=JgIBoJDRsS4q5gIGXkALnSo0r8UJQyuDyZVaE-7FdM8&e=2bb0250de6a743cf472d1821e5b3b009&utm_source=mobrooksforsen&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=maga_mo_monday_1_31_3&n=5) **Last Week** Last week we made dozens of stops on the campaign trail. We covered Madison, Limestone, Morgan, Escambia, Jefferson, and Marshall Counties. I toured some great local businesses, including Colormasters in Albertville and R&D Electronics in Brownsboro. We had a great meet-and-greet in Albertville. Thank you to everyone who came out! I also spoke to a number of phenomenal GOP groups. They must have liked my proven Conservative message because people took home a lot of yard signs! We also spoke to a bunch of local media. Did you catch me on the radio this week? **This Week** This week, I’ll be back in Washington to fight the Socialists’ March on America. Nancy Pelosi is keeping the House of Representatives agenda close to her vest so she can try to catch Republicans by surprise to push through her radical agenda. I’ll be ready to fight and block any of her bad legislation that she tries to sneak through this week. **In the News** I talked with Breitbart News’ Jeff Poor about who I would support as Senate Majority Leader. HINT: Probably NOT Mitch McConnell! Read it [HERE](https://mobrooksforsen.nationbuilder.com/r?u=s24IZE3rULlhCWzRMLn9n_f206ZN7euiN0RCnUNpEgXXVK0NXhMYZUgGEZWXD5KX62YXE4sWWbBgQVpZYgreDbRBExajaLTQgai6T-1UBprs6A2d-SuGwqeICv5_s1HWcdYwJ2oGdWGGhUA8lo3rYpt_mG0kXOwz7KkRl_F7CPPwyDeFaylY9Zku6nKQVHqO_1Hv1d45a7s3kDpMHR-ZVA&e=2bb0250de6a743cf472d1821e5b3b009&utm_source=mobrooksforsen&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=maga_mo_monday_1_31_3&n=6). I sat down in-person with the Sand Mountain Reporter in Albertville this past week. We had a great in-depth discussion! We covered why I’m in this race, why I’m the ONLY Conservative running, and what I will do in the Senate. Check it out [HERE](https://mobrooksforsen.nationbuilder.com/r?u=srcmc-ocRNj6Zr8LCyJfXq4y41SNoG0TZEKPmXl8b04TP3ts6sUASNHazNfJbCZatUPN1r_hezakz2l-siy9NhY_jfeQQaxnhelehUMF6wbaPYqxkJC94nqJlFFQ1fb23HwyYdGCMW4cDkwRqexXEA&e=2bb0250de6a743cf472d1821e5b3b009&utm_source=mobrooksforsen&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=maga_mo_monday_1_31_3&n=7). **Get Involved** This campaign is powered by you. Conservative grassroots leaders across Alabama are the backbone of this campaign. If you haven't signed up to volunteer, you can do so[ HERE](https://mobrooksforsen.nationbuilder.com/r?u=hvw5smsGZmC0zsVkF6hKG4VT3iyu91onNSLG8ZGGFleveBv8QA-CfxJ-FwPOFlxZ&e=2bb0250de6a743cf472d1821e5b3b009&utm_source=mobrooksforsen&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=maga_mo_monday_1_31_3&n=8)! If you know someone looking to intern, or if you want to get more involved, email the team at [info@mobrooks.com](mailto:info@mobrooks.com) so we can connect. **Pictures of the Week** I loved joining my friend and former State Senator Scott Beason on WYDE radio. Scott even endorsed my campaign! I had a great time in Vestavia Hills at the can’t-miss Jefferson County GOP Pancakes and Politics event! What a great crowd, and you can’t go wrong starting your weekend with pancakes. I had a great interview with Sara at the Advertiser Gleam in Guntersville. Be on the lookout for the article this week. Be sure to check out all of our posts from last week and be sure to like us, follow us and most importantly SHARE us on[ Facebook](https://mobrooksforsen.nationbuilder.com/r?u=27Ax0UmWOX2J8J_QwK9Z6sJAQfbjrgl12zjz4yECp3EspAYwyHliJnJgvrx2-6Fd&e=2bb0250de6a743cf472d1821e5b3b009&utm_source=mobrooksforsen&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=maga_mo_monday_1_31_3&n=9),[ Twitter](https://mobrooksforsen.nationbuilder.com/r?u=YqgukYA3Mrlri-dqG7I8TvQpzdP2h-MkR1RgQ68Ld6g&e=2bb0250de6a743cf472d1821e5b3b009&utm_source=mobrooksforsen&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=maga_mo_monday_1_31_3&n=10), [GETTR](https://mobrooksforsen.nationbuilder.com/r?u=9zp-qDZJxKJVUKiD6t2SH1K76vrY-7l5rg_tQBNbqtJYYnw1cnhvuOyPPsq9Om-8&e=2bb0250de6a743cf472d1821e5b3b009&utm_source=mobrooksforsen&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=maga_mo_monday_1_31_3&n=11), and[ Instagram](https://mobrooksforsen.nationbuilder.com/r?u=6hyvAYXBs1PELL28GD73ywFhIE26WWSjD3TNoGUDBzjurmiCr1IGU1y66ajEMFQdM3N4Eq0EkGZlk8wprVldYQ&e=2bb0250de6a743cf472d1821e5b3b009&utm_source=mobrooksforsen&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=maga_mo_monday_1_31_3&n=12). **Endorsement of the Week** “I’m here to endorse my great friend Mo Brooks. There’s a situation in D.C. where we need fighters, a lot of times you don’t see people of courage step up and stand out. Mo Brooks has proven time and time again that he is a fighter.” Have a great week and see you on the trail soon, Mo P.S. The establishment is terrified of me, because I will never work for special interests, I will only work for you. I'm never going to support cheap foreign labor and I don't support open borders, which is why they're doing all they can to stop our campaign. | | Peter, Mary, Andy's wife here. Right now, I'm organizing the petition drive to get Andy on the ballot for the new 11th district – and I really love it. It means reaching out to friends, colleagues, activists, public officials, community organizers to talk about the campaign, to talk about what we hope for, to talk about the leadership we need to get things done in Washington. I know, I’m married to him, so of course I’m a booster. But truly, I believe Andy is so motivated to make the world a better place that he will work tirelessly to serve his constituents, to serve the country. Is democracy in the balance? It is. Enough is enough: We need to defeat Sen. Grassley
| | | Hey Peter, it's Abby again. I know you've heard from me and my team a lot these past few days, but I just have one more update before signing off for tonight. We're still about $2,500 short of what we need to raise before our end-of-month fundraising deadline in a few hours. We're _so close_ to getting where we need to be, and I really appreciate how hard you and this team have worked to show our strength ahead of a big moment for our campaign.

body:
With all that’s going on, we haven’t been focused on the usual campaign stuff. And that’s okay.
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220131-2757-header&t=1&akid=2757%2E2526796%2ECSJb5Z)
Honestly, this has been a tough month. With all that’s going on, we haven’t been focused on the usual campaign stuff. And that’s okay!
This month Alexandria endorsed Jessica Cisneros running in Texas’ 28th district to unseat the last anti-choice Democrat in the House — and helped to raise tens of thousands of dollars for her campaign to recruit volunteers and contact as many voters as possible.
Alexandria stood alongside app delivery workers who fought for and won major protections in New York, and she visited apartment buildings whose heating systems flooded to learn more and accelerate relief for families who are currently without heat.
On top of all that, New York had its worst fire in three decades in the Bronx, killing 17 people. We raised funds as a movement to support relief efforts and are working to ensure safe and dignified housing for all.
Fundraising for our campaign has been on the back burner. And, again, that’s okay. Alexandria’s focus has been on what matters most during this turbulent month.
**But, it does leave us with a pretty big gap in fundraising, and that’s why we really could use your help today.** [If you are able, can you chip in $3 right now to help us close this gap in fundraising and meet our January target?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220131-1?refcode=em20220131-2757-P_FND_EOM_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&refcode2=2757_2526796_CSJb5Z&akid=2757%2E2526796%2ECSJb5Z)

We’ve only raised about 70% this month as we had at this point in December. That’s why we need to have a really big end-of-month fundraising surge to ensure we don’t fall too far behind.
Our average donation this month is $15.10. So to hit our January goal, it would take somewhere around 993 of you chipping in that amount to close the gap.
[If you can be one of those people today, it would mean so much. Click here to contribute and help us close the gap.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220131-1?refcode=em20220131-2757-P_FND_EOM_GOL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&refcode2=2757_2526796_CSJb5Z&akid=2757%2E2526796%2ECSJb5Z)
This team has never let us down before. But, whether or not we close this gap, we have a lot to be proud of this month.
Thank you for all you do,
Team AOC

Hey there – It’s Gillian.
Reaching out just before midnight to let you know that we’re about to face our first FEC deadline since Ron Johnson announced that he would be running for a third term in the Senate.

This is a longer note about who I am and why I am in this fight, and I hope you’ll take a moment to read it all the way through
| Hi friend,

I wanted to take a moment today to write a longer note about who I am and why I am in this fight. I hope you’ll take a moment to read it all the way through, but if you don’t have time (that’s okay!), [**please consider splitting a contribution of $5 or more between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to help us build a people-powered movement to bring real change to Long Island and protect our Democratic House Majority.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/5490?t=6&akid=1204%2E878179%2EsERONv) | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/5490?t=7&akid=1204%2E878179%2EsERONv)
---
[CONTRIBUTE MORE »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/5518?t=8&akid=1204%2E878179%2EsERONv)
**Friend, my journey to running for Congress is deeply rooted in my commitment to our country and our community.** _This fight is personal to me._

As a first-generation immigrant, I came to the United States from Jamaica at just seven years old, and I watched my father rise from a railroad worker to an attorney. The drive to defend and expand the opportunities that allowed him to do so inspired me to live a life of service -- first in the US Army Reserves, then our public schools and town council, and [**with your support**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/5490?t=9&akid=1204%2E878179%2EsERONv), in the halls of Congress.

I became an educator in New York public schools to fulfill my lifelong dream. At the same time, I served in the Army Reserves for 29 years, deploying to Iraq, Afghanistan, Guantanamo Bay, and Germany for Operation Desert Storm. I knew I wanted to continue serving at home after returning from Iraq, so I ran for my local town council.

**Now, after three decades of serving locally and abroad, I am ready to fight tooth and nail to put our community first in Congress.** I’m running because Long Island deserves a leader who will fight for lower health care costs, better public safety, proper care for our veterans, and a fair tax system. _But I can’t do this without you._
[**So I’m asking, personally: Will you chip in $5 or more between my campaign and Voter Protection Project? Any amount will go a long way in building the grassroots foundation we’ll need to win NY-02 and keep the House blue this year.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/5490?t=10&akid=1204%2E878179%2EsERONv)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/5514?t=11&akid=1204%2E878179%2EsERONv)
---

[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/5516?t=13&akid=1204%2E878179%2EsERONv)

[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/5518?t=15&akid=1204%2E878179%2EsERONv)
Take care and walk good,

_Jackie_

body:
Over the coming months I’ll continue to bring my optimistic message of hope to citizens in every corner of our state. | | | |
---
| | |
### **Relentless Campaigner**
### **Knows all of Michigan**
### **Knows the Issues**
---
|
---
| Peter:

It’s been another great week on the campaign trail.

I attended a wonderful event in Wayne County, the Republican Committee Unity Dinner. Chair Cheryl Costantino and crew did a fantastic job.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| It was a pleasure speaking to the attendees about my background of service to this country — 4 years in the U.S. Marine Corps and 33 years in the Michigan State Police where I continue crime fighting by day. As the only lifelong Republican and twice elected Republican County Commissioner, I am the only candidate who has even successfully run and won as a Republican candidate and have been undefeated. In my daily life as a State Police Captain I manage almost 200 people. Having spent my career building high performing teams I will FIX Michigan for the citizens of this state that have been disrespected by our current Governor.
---
| |
---
Later in the week, I attended the 6th District Republican meeting where I gave an update on my race for Governor and emphasized my belief that we need a candidate who is a lifelong Republican, who has the energy and vitality to campaign relentlessly in all corners of the state, and who has a working knowledge of all of Michigan.
---
| In Grand Rapids I had an awesome outing at the Huntin' Time Expo. As the only candidate who actively enjoys hunting, fishing, camping, and the outdoor lifestyle, I understand the issues facing the sporting industry. I will be a strong advocate for the outdoors and common sense conservation policies in Michigan.
---
|
---
---
| Finally, I was the only candidate for Governor (Republican or Democrat) to be part of School Choice Week with Parent Advocates for Choice in Education and the The Mackinac Center for Public Policy.

Michigan celebrated National School Choice Week 2022 with 772 events this week.
---
|
---
|
---
---
| It is all the more important that parents have options, especially with the radical elements that have been infiltrating our public schools promoting insidious concepts like critical race theory.

We must ensure that all students and parents have every option available because no two students are alike.

I’ll fight to expand opportunities for all parents because each and every child deserves the best education possible.

Over the coming months I’ll continue to bring my optimistic message of hope to citizens in every corner of our state.

See you on the campaign trail.

Michael Brown
Republican for Governor
