It's hard to believe that the first month of 2022 is already coming to a close. Election Day will be here before we know it, so I wanted to take a moment to share a little bit about where our race for Washington's 8th District stands. Peter,

It's hard to believe that the first month of 2022 is already coming to a close. Election Day will be here before we know it, so I wanted to take a moment to share a little bit about where our race for Washington's 8th District stands.

After redistricting, the new WA-08 will not only remain the most competitive race in the state – it will also be one of the most competitive in the entire country. This new map also means I have over 100,000 new voters that I need to reach, and less than a year to do it.

Election experts are now calling our race a "toss-up" and with three Republican opponents running to flip this seat, we know we're in for our toughest race yet.

We can't hold the House majority without winning in Washington's 8th District. We can win, but it won't be easy. That's why it's crucial we reach our first end-of-month fundraising goal of the election year by midnight tonight to make sure we have the resources we need to reach new voters and defend this seat.

| | "The show must go on!" - a common line cited by devoted actors. It means that no matter what happens the show must continue.

For some candidates, this is their exact mentatlity. We have a number of showmen attempting to get elected and they will continue to put on their best show regardless of their hypocritical background/reputation/stances. The words are there, but the substance is not.

Fellow Nebraskans, our government and party platforms are riddled with substance-lacking showmen and it's motivated me to run for governor, to give Nebraskans a different choice. Our liberties and future success is under attack by not only many Democrats, but many Republicans, too. So I urge you, fellow Nebraskans, please look into all candidates and pass the information on to your friends, family, churches, 4-H groups, etc. We are desperate for informed voters that will not tow party lines and will vote for candidates that pledge to not do the same.

I am a Republican and I am running on the Republican platform, but before that, I am a Nebraskan and I am an American. I care about making our home a better state for my family and yours. Any person or party that seeks to get in the way of that will not be tolerated.

The primaries are a mere few months away. If we want meaningful change and protection of our freedoms in this state, we need to continue the fight like our future depends on it - because it does.

The support of thousands of Nebraskans is humbling and greatly appreciated. I encourage you to support my campaign wherever you are capable and willing to do so. Word of mouth, handing out flyers, planting yard signs, prayer, and donating to the campaign has a significant impact. We need the support more than ever for this last stretch to the finish line!

I look forward to continue serving Nebraskans as a candidate and I truly hope to personally meet every one of you.

Until next time!

Breland Ridenour

| | What We've Been Up To
---
| | Team Ridenour is beginning to prepare for the stretch that lies ahead. As you may already know, the May 10th GOP primary is just around the corner! We'll fill you in on what Breland's been up to, but we're going to place even more focus on what's ahead. Crunch time is quickly approaching.
To start January off, he attended the Cow Country Gubernatorial Forum at the Hyannis High School. This was a great opportunity to show West-Central Nebraskans just how different he is from the other Republican candidates. That forum, along with other recent events around the rural parts of the state, has offered great feedback for the campaign. A lot of folks seem very receptive of Breland's lack of industry bias when it comes to our state Ag industry. A lack of experience doesn't imply a lack of care; on the contrary, people seem hungry for a fresh open mind who's actually willing to listen to the needs of our farmers! He had a busy weekend of January 8th and 9th, as he participated in the Valley County Winter Gala in Ord, NE as well as the Gubernatorial Candidate Forum in Wakefield, NE. This was yet another great weekend of opportunities to provide a contrast for conservative voters amidst the other candidates. On January 20th, Breland participated in the Lincoln County Cattlemen's Candidate's Forum in North Platte. As you can already tell, these side-by-side opportunities for voters to compare candidates have been increasing as primary season begins to heat up! Breland's message that centers around Liberty has been resonating with lots of folks, especially out in Central and Western Nebraska. He plans to continue to travel the state to reach these often overlooked voters, as well as begin to make his push into the Omaha and Lincoln metro area in the Eastern part of the state. As some of you may have seen recently in the news and on social media, the mudslinging has begun to amp up a bit more between some campaigns. Breland prides himself on running a clean, POSITIVE campaign amidst the other candidates who are entering into turbulent political waters. We like to think that this is what voters want, and anything less becomes discouraging and even damaging to credibility. In other news, this past weekend Nebraska became the 17th state to join the call for a Convention of the States. This is important news, as it organically highlights some of the key aspects of Breland's message in general. He's been one of the more vocal proponents of the CoS, and this will hopefully lead more eyeballs to look toward his campaign! If you haven't seen it yet, his most recent post on Facebook highlights this fact as well as factors that revolve around it - including the very concept our nation was founded on - the Doctrine of the Lesser Magistrates. Granting Statehood to Washington, D.C. will finally bring representation to 700,000 people (more people than in Vermont _or_ Wyoming).

And by making statehood a reality, **we can also add 2 Progressive Senators and EXPAND our fragile Senate majority!

name: JusticeDemocrats.com
subject: Super PAC just endorsed against 3 of our candidates
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, we've seen
this before.

A Republican-funded Super PAC called the Democratic Majority for Israel
(DMFI) just endorsed against three of our candidates.

In the 2020 presidential primary, DMFI spent a ton of money running TV ads
smearing Bernie Sanders. DMFI was desperately scared of progressives
winning power, and they still are.

Also in 2020, DMFI spent $2 million against Jamaal Bowman, smearing him
with ugly attack ads in NY-16’s congressional primary.

Now, DMFI is officially working against Summer Lee, Marie Newman, and Rana
Abdelhamid. The political establishment is working hard to stop Justice
Democrats from winning their primaries, just like they did to Bernie and
just like they tried to do to Jamaal.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/91528?refcode=em20220131-21766&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=21766%2E1203867%2ENocP0R ]We need the help of our grassroots supporters to defeat right-wing
foreign policy hawks and elect our slate of Justice Democrats. Can you
rush a $3 donation before midnight to help us fight back
against the establishment?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/91528?refcode=em20220131-21766&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=21766%2E1203867%2ENocP0R ]Contribute $3

Here’s what Bernie said in response to the smear campaign DMFI ran against
Jamaal Bowman in 2020:

“The ‘Democratic Majority for Israel’ is a corporate/Republican-funded super PAC
that runs ugly, negative ads against progressives. This is establishment
big-money politics at its worst, and why we have to transform the Democratic
Party.”

The news that DMFI is endorsing against Summer, Marie, and Rana comes just
as we’re trying to hit our January fundraising goal. It’s critical that we
hit our goal (and we’re so close), but we need our supporters to step up.
We can only win our primaries by working together and fueling the work
from small-dollar donations.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/91528?refcode=em20220131-21766&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=21766%2E1203867%2ENocP0R ]Rush a donation to Justice Democrats right now to ensure we have the
funds to mount primaries against foreign policy hawks and the political
establishment.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1023&akid=21766%2E1203867%2ENocP0R ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1024&akid=21766%2E1203867%2ENocP0R ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20220131-21766-footer&t=1025&refcode2=21766_1203867_NocP0R&akid=21766%2E1203867%2ENocP0R

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://go.justicedemocrats.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=1026&akid=21766%2E1203867%2ENocP0R

Right now, voters are turning their backs on Henry Cuellar in light of the FBI probe and are tired of watching him align himself with Republicans on policies that impact thousands of South Texans. But we can’t bet on winning just because Cuellar is under investigation, especially since we are still being massively outraised and outspent by Cuellar and his corporate funders.
